Ka an-anayan ne baseen meyitenged te me

The first document about

Hari

Kings

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka an-anayan ne baseen meyitenged te me Hari sumpul te guhuren meyitenged te migharian te me Israilita ne migbunsud te baseen ni Samwil. Nabaad seini te tatelu: 1/ Ka pegsubal ni Sulumun isip Hari te nasud te Israil, wey ka pegpatey te amey rin ne si Dabid. 2/ Ka peghari ni Sulumun wey ka me kalampusan din, labi en iya ka peggimu te timplu te Hirusalim. 3/ Ka pegkabaad te migharian te Israil te daruwa: ka migharian ne dapit te igkahibang ne balabahan, wey ka migharian ne dapit te igkakawanan ne balabahan, wey ka me guhuren meyitenged te me Hari ne migpangulu kandan taman te siyam ne gatus wey lalimma ne pulu (950) ne leg-un te ware pad neetew si Hisus.

The first document of Kings is a continuation of the story about the kingdom of the Israilitas which started in the document of Samwil. It is divided into three: 1/ The taking_place of Sulumun as a king of nation of Israil, and the death of his father Dabid. 2/ The kinging by Sulumun and his successes, especially the making of the temple of Hirusalim. 3/ The division of the kingdom of Israil into two: the northern (LIT on the left_side) kingdom, and the southern (LIT on the right_side) kingdom, and the stories about the kings (who) led them until nine hundred fifty (950) years before Jesus was_born.

Kayi te daruwa ne baseen meyitenged te me Hari, inggukuman ka tagse pangulu sumale te pegkamatinumanen dan te Manama, wey nanengnengan ne ka kalampusan te intiru ne nasud egpakaparuma-ruma te pegkamatinumanen dan. Ka pegsimba te me diyus-diyus wey ka pegkamasinupaken, egpakabehey te karereetan. Ne ware miglampus te seini ne peg-eleg-eleg ka langun ne Hari te migharian ne dapit te igkahibang ne balabahan. Piru due mule miglampus ne me Hari te migharian ne dapit te igkakawanan ne balabahan, wey due degma ware miglampus.

Here in two documents concerning Kings, each leader was_judged according to their faithfulness to God (MS Manama), and (it's) found_out that the success of the entire nation depends_on (LIT goes_along_with) his faithfulness. Worshiping of false_gods and disobedience, can_cause (LIT can_give) destruction/disaster. And all kings of the northern (LIT on the left of east) kingdom didn't succeed in this testing. But there_(were) kings of the southern (LIT on the right side) kingdom who succeeded in this test, and there (were) also those who didn't.

Ne ka amana neneila ne me etew te An-anayan ne baseen meyitenged te me Hari, iyan ka me prupita te Magbebaye ne Manama ne mabbagget ne me talagpangguhud te lalag te Manama ne migpaneypaney te me etew ne kene egsimba te me diyus-diyus, wey kene egsupak te Manama. Labi en iya si Ilyas wey ka panugtulen meyitenged te pegkuntere din te me prupita ni Baal (kapitulu 18).

And the people who are well_known in the First documents of Kings, were the prophets of the Lord God who_were courageous tellers of the word of God who warned the people not to worship false_gods, and not to disobey God. Especially Ilyas and the story about his countering the prophets of Baal (chapter 18).

Ka kabuyahi ni Hari Dabid

The old_age of King Dabid

11 Ne hengkayi te buyag e si Hari Dabid, amane e sikandin egkaagsil minsan egmeg-ak-akeben pad ka me ulesen ne igbukus kandin te me suluhuanen din. 2 Purisu, migkahiyan sikandin te me suluhuanen din, “Ahalen, egkaayun ded ne egpammitawan ney sikeykew te mengebay ne egtanud-tanud egtanggu wey eggulid keykew eyew kene kad egkaagsilan?” 3 Ne migpamitew sikandan te mateles ne mengebay diye te intiru ne Israil wey si Abisag ne matig-Sunam ka nakita ran, wey in-uyan dan e sikandin diye te Hari. 4 Amana ne tetelesi ka mengebay, wey neyimu sikandin ne talagtanggu te Hari. Piru ware sikandin hilabeti te Hari.

11 Now when King Dabid was very old, he was very cold even_though the blankets that he was_wrapped_in were_given_extra_layers by his servants. 2 Therefore, he was_told by his servants, “Master, can we(excl) look_for an unmarried_girl to carefully look_after you(sg) and lie_with you(sg) so_that you(sg) won't be_cold?” 3 So they searched for a beautiful unmarried_girl there in entire Israil and Abisag from_Sunam (was) the (one) they found, and they took her to the king. 4 The girl was very beautiful, and she became the carer of the king. But the king did not have_sexual_relations with her.

Egkeupian si Aduniyas ne egkeyimu ne Hari

Aduniyas wants to become king

5 [xr]Te seeye ne timpu, migpaambug e mule si Aduniyas ne anak ni Dabid ki Hagit, “Sikeddiey ka eghari.” Purisu mig-andam e sikandin te me karwahi, me etew ne egmangukudde, wey lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me etew ne eggun-a kandin. 6 Ware de due sikandin nasapari minsan ken-u te amey rin ne si Dabid, wey ke mig-insaan naa ke mareet ka eggimuwen din. Amana ne mateles ne lukes si Aduniyas, wey sikandin ka inggiba ni Absalum. 7 Ne miglalahan din si Huwab ne anak ni Siruya, wey si Abiyatar ne talagpanubad, meyitenged te planu rin ne egkeyimu sikandin ne Hari, wey mig-uyun ne egbulig sikandan se daruwa. 8 Piru ware mig-uyun ne egbulig kandin ensi Saduk ne talagpanubad, si Binayas ne anak ni Hihuyada, si Natan ne prupita, si Simii, si Ri, wey ka me sinalihan ne sundalu ni Dabid.

5 [xr]At that time, Aduniyas the child of Dabid with Hagit got_proud on_the_contrary (saying), “I will_become_king.” Therefore he prepared chariots, people riding_horses, and fifty (50) people to precede him. 6 He hadn't been_scolded even once (LIT even when) by his father Dabid, or questioned if what_ he _did was bad. Aduniyas was a very handsome man, and he was_born_next_after Absalum. 7 And he spoke to Huwab the child of Siruya, and (to) Abiyatar the sacrificer, about his plan to become king, and the two agreed to_help him. 8 But Saduk the sacrificer, Binayas the child of Hihuyada, Natan the prophet, Simii, Ri, and the trusted soldiers of Dabid didn't agree to_help him.

9 Sabeka ne aldew, migpanubad si Aduniyas te karniru, turu ne baka, wey te impalambeg ne me baka diye te Batu ne Suhilit ne marani te sebseb ne Inrugil. Ingginggat din ka langun ne suled din ne me lukes ne anak te Hari, wey ka me upisyal te Hari puun te Huda eyew egtambung te seeye ne pegpanubad. 10 Piru ware din hinggata si Natan ne prupita, si Binayas, ka me sinalihan ne sundalu te Hari, wey ka suled din ne si Sulumun.

9 One day, Aduniyas sacrificed sheep, male cows, and the fattened cows there at Suhilit Rock near the spring that's Inrugil. He invited all his siblings/cousins the king's male children, and the officials of the king from Huda in_order to_attend that sacrificing. 10 But he didn't invite Natan the prophet, Binayas, the trusted soldiers of the king, and his brother Sulumun.

Ka peggimu ki Sulumun ne Hari

The making of Sulumun as king

11 [xr]Ne miggendiye si Natan te ki Batsiba ne iney ni Sulumun wey mig-insaan din sikandin, “Nakarineg kad e te neyimu e ne Hari si Aduniyas ne anak ni Hagit? Ware pe ma nakanengneng si Hari Dabid meyitenged due. 12 Purisu, emun ke egkeupian ka ne kene egkareetan wey ka anak nu ne si Sulumun, tumana nu ka tambag ku keykew. 13 Hendiye ka te ki Hari Dabid wey kahii nu sikandin, ‘Ahalen ku ne Hari, migsaad ka dengan keddiey ne ka anak ku ne si Sulumun ka egpakasubal keykew ne eghari. Ne mania te si Aduniyas e ka neyimu ne Hari?’ ” 14 Ne migkahi e man-e si Natan, “Taheed te egpakiglalag ke pad te Hari, eglasud ad, wey egpamalehetan ku ka inlalag nu kandin.”

11 [xr]And Natan went to Batsiba the mother of Sulumun and he asked her, “Have_ you(sg) _heard that Aduniyas the child of Hagit has_become king? King Dabid doesn't even know about it. 12 Therefore, if you(sg) want to not be_destroyed and your(sg) child Sulumun, obey(sg) my advice to_you(sg). 13 Go(sg) to King Dabid and tell(sg) him, ‘My master king, you(sg) promised before to_me that my child Sulumun (would be) the (one who) would_replace you(sg) in kinging. And why has Aduniyas become king?’ ” 14 And Natan spoke again, “While you(sg) are still speaking_with the king, I will_enter, and I will_witness to what_ you(sg) _told him.”

15 Purisu miggendiyad e si Batsiba te sinabeng te Hari. Buyag e amana ka Hari, wey si Abisag ne matig-Sunam ka migtanggu kandin. 16 Ne migpanimbuel wey miglangkeb si Batsiba diye te tangkaan te Hari. Ne mig-insaan e sikandin te Hari, “Nekey ka igkeupii nu?”

15 Therefore Batsiba went_there to the room of the king. The king was very old, and Abisag from_Sunam (was) the (one) looking_after him. 16 And Batsiba kneeled and laid_prostrate there in front of the king. And she was_asked by the king, “What do you(sg) want?”

17 Ne migtabak si Batsiba, “Ahalen, migsaad ka dengan keddi te ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama nu ne ka anak ku ne si Sulumun ka igpasubal nu igpapinnuu te trunu nu te Hari. 18 Ne kuntee, si Aduniyas e mule ka neyimu ne Hari, ne ware ka mule nakanengneng. 19 Migpanubad e sikandin te masulug ne karniru, turu ne baka, wey te impalambeg ne me baka, wey impanginggat din ka langun ne me anak nu, wey si Abiyatar ne talagpanubad, wey si Huwab ne pangulu te me sundalu, piru ware din mule hinggata si Sulumun ne suluhuanen nu. 20 Ne kuntee ahalen, egtetahad ka langun ne etew te Israil ke hentew ka igpanengneng nu ne igpasubal nu keykew ne eghari. 21 Su ke kene nu eggimuwen sika, te timpu ne eg-engked kad e kanami, eg-isipen ad e nikandan ne talag-akal wey ka anak ku ne si Sulumun.”

17 And Batsiba answered, “Master, you(sg) promised me before in the name of the Lord your(sg) God that my child Sulumun (would be) the (one) replacing you(sg) sitting on your(sg) throne as king. 18 And now/today, Aduniyas on_the_contrary became king, and you(sg) didn't even know. 19 He sacrificed many sheeps, male cows, and fattened cow, and he invited all your(sg) children, and Abiyatar the sacrificer, and Huwab the leader of the soldiers, but on_the_contrary he didn't invite Sulumun your(sg) servant. 20 And now/today master, all the people of Israil are_waiting for who you(sg) will_inform that replaces you(sg) in kinging. 21 Because if you(sg) don't do that, at the time that you(sg) leave us(excl), me and my child Sulumun will_be_considered by_them as traitors.”

22 Taheed te egpakiglalag pad si Batsiba te Hari, miggingume e si Natan ne prupita. 23 Ne ingguhuran e ka Hari te due si Natan. Ne dutu, miglasud e si Natan wey mig-usengul sikandin diye te tangkaan te Hari. 24 Ne migkahi sikandin, “Ahalen ku ne Hari, impanengneng nud ka me etew ne si Aduniyas iya ka igpasubal nu igpahari? 25 Su kuntee ne aldew, migpanubad sikandin te masulug ne karniru, me turu ne baka, wey te impalambeg ne me baka. Ingginggat din ka langun ne me anak nu, ka pangulu te me sundalu wey si Abiyatar ne talagpanubad. Ne kuntee, sasangan pad sikandan ne egmangekeen, egmangiinum, wey egmanguleyi ne egbantug ki Aduniyas ne iyan e Hari. 26 Piru wara a mule hinggata nikandin se suluhuanen nu, wey si Saduk ne talagpanubad, si Binayas ne anak ni Hihuyada, wey ka suluhuanen nu ne si Sulumun. 27 Ahalen, mig-uyunan nu iya seini minsan ware key nikeykew panengnenga se me suluhuanen nu ke hentew ka igpasubal nu igpahari?”

22 While Batsiba was_ still _speaking_with the king, Natan the prophet arrived. 23 And the king was_storied that Natan was there. And then, Natan entered and he bowed there in front of the king. 24 And he said, “My master king, did you(sg) inform the people that Aduniyas indeed (was) the (one) replacing you(sg) to_be_king? 25 Because today, he sacrificed many sheep, male cows, and fattened cows. He invited all your(sg) children, the leader of the soldiers and Abiyatar the sacrificer. And now/today, they continue eating(pl), drinking(pl), and shouting that Aduniyas is_respected/honored that he is king already. 26 But I your(sg) servant, and Saduk the sacrificer, Binayas son of Hihuyada, and your(sg) servant Sulumun he didn't invite on_the_contrary. 27 Master, did_ you(sg) _approve this even though we(excl) your(sg) servants weren't informed by_you(sg) who would_replace you(sg) as_king?”

28 Ne migkahi si Hari Dabid, “Ipaseled niyu pa man-e kayi si Batsiba.” Ne migseled e si Batsiba wey migsasindeg sikandin diye te tangkaan te Hari. 29 Ne migkahiyan e sikandin te Hari, “Mengeyibet iya te manekal ne Manama ne iyan migluwas keddiey ligkat te langun ne karereetan, 30 ne ka insaad ku keykew te ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil, ne ka anak nu ne si Sulumun iya ka igpasubal ku igpahari. Ne egtumanen ku seini kuntee ne aldew.”

28 And King Dabid said, “Get_ Batsiba _to_come_in here.” And Batsiba came_in and stood there in front of the king. 29 And she was_told by the king, “I indeed swear by the living/strong God who saved me from all destructions, 30 that (what) I promised you(sg) in the name of the Lord God of Israil, that your(sg) child Sulumun indeed will_replace me in_kinging. And I will_fulfill this/it today.”

31 Ne mig-usengul wey miglangkeb e si Batsiba diye te tangkaan te Hari wey migkahi, “Egkeuyag ka te ware egtamanan, ahalen!”

31 And Batsiba bowed_low and laid_prostrate before the king and said, “May you(sg) live without ending, master!”

32 Ne migkahi si Hari Dabid, “Ipeendini niyu si Saduk ne talagpanubad, si Natan ne prupita, wey si Binayas ne anak ni Hihuyada.” Te diyad e sikandan te tangkaan te Hari, 33 migkahiyan e sikandan te Hari, “Dumaa niyu ka me upisyal ku, wey ipeuntud niyu ka anak ku ne si Sulumun te kudde ku,[fn] wey dumeyi niyu sikandin patupang diye te sebseb te Gihun. 34 Ne diye, eg-itisan ni Saduk ne talagpanubad, wey ni Natan ne prupita ka ulu ni Sulumun te lana eyew egkeyimu sikandin ne Hari te Israil. Ne parahinga niyu ka trumpita duma te pegpanguleyi, ‘Egkeuyag te ware egtamanan si Hari Sulumun!’ 35 Pegkapenga due, ipanulud niyud e sikandin kayi. Ipaseled niyu wey ipapinnuu niyu sikandin te trunu ku, su eghari e sikandin subal keddiey. Sikandin ka in-alam ku ne eghari te Israil wey te Huda.”

32 And King Dabid said, “Bring(pl) Saduk the sacrificer, Natan the prophet, and Binayas the child of Hihuyada here_to_me.” When they were_there in front of the king, 33 they were_told by the king, “Bring(pl)_ my officials _with you(pl), and mount(pl) my child Sulumun on a horse,[fn] and accompany(pl) him descending to the spring of Gihun. 34 And there, Sulumun's head will_be_poured_ oil _on by Saduk the sacrificer, and by Natan the prophet so_that he will_become the king of Israil. And sound(pl) the trumpet along_with shouting, ‘May King Sulumun live without ending!’ 35 After that, escort(pl) him here. Bring(pl)_in and seat(pl) him on my throne, because he will_king replacing me. He (is) the (one who) I have_chosen to king over Israil and over Huda.”

36 Ne migtabak si Binayas te Hari, “Uya, ahalen! Egpamalehetan perem sika te Magbebaye ne Manama nu. 37 Su ka Magbebaye ne migduma keykew, egduma red degma ki Sulumun eyew egmabmabantug pad ka peghari din te peghari nu.”

36 And Binayas answered the king, “Yes, master! May that be_witnessed by the Lord your(sg) God. 37 Because the Lord that accompanies you(sg), also accompany Sulumun in_order to_become_respected in his kinging even_more than your(sg) kinging.”

38 Ne nangipanew e ensi Saduk, Natan, wey si Binayas ne indumaan te me talagbantey[fn] te Hari. Impeuntud dan si Sulumun te kudde te Hari wey nangendiyad e sikandan te Gihun. 39 Pegginguma ran diye, ingkuwe e ni Saduk ka lana te ulibu ne intahu te sungey ne in-uyan din puun te Balungbalung te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey in-itisan din e si Sulumun. Ne dutu, imparahing dan e ka trumpita wey immanguleyi e ka langun ne etew, “Egkeuyag te ware egtamanan si Hari Sulumun!” 40 Ne miglibed e sikandan diye te Hirusalim ka egmamulendag wey egmanguleyi te pegkahale dan, ka migsinundul ki Sulumun. Amana sikandan ne maggulub wey egka-antag e ka tane te kahulub dan.

38 And Saduk, Natan, and Binayas left accompanied_by the guards[fn] of the king. They mounted Sulumun on the horse of the king and they(pl) went to Gihun. 39 When they got there, Saduk took the olive oil which is stored in a horn which he had brought from the Tent of the Lord God, and he poured_(it)_over Sulumun. And then, they sounded the trumpet and all people shouted(pl), “May King Sulumun live without ending!” 40 And they returned to Hirusalim playing_flutes and shouting with joy, following Sulumun. They were_ very _noisy and the ground vibrated with their noise.

41 Te egmekeimpus e egmangekeen ensi Aduniyas duma te me mahaliyug din, narineg dan e ka mahulub. Te narineg e degma ni Huwab ka laheng te trumpita, mig-inse e sikandin, “Mania te amana ne mahulub ka diye te siyudad?” 42 Te sasangan pad ne eglalag si Huwab, miggingume e si Diyunatan ne anak te talagpanubad ne si Abiyatar. Ne migkahi e si Aduniyas, “Lasud ka, talahuren, kema ke due meupiya ne panugtulen nu.”

41 When Aduniyas along_with his guests (were) about to finish(pl) eating(pl), they heard the noise. When Huwab also heard the sound of the trumpet, he asked, “Why's it very noisy there in the city?” 42 While Huwab was_speaking still, Diyunatan the child of the sacrificer Abiyatar arrived. And Aduniyas said, “Enter, respected (one), maybe you(sg) have a good story.”

43 Ne migtabak si Diyunatan, “Kene ne meupiya ne panugtulen! Inggimu e ne Hari si Sulumun te ahalen ta ne si Hari Dabid. 44 Imparumaan din si Sulumun engki Saduk, Natan, Binayas wey te me talagbantey rin wey impeuntud dan sikandin te kudde te Hari. 45 Ne diye te sebseb te Gihun, mig-itisan e enni Saduk wey ni Natan ka ulu ni Sulumun te lana eyew egkeyimu e sikandin ne Hari. Ne nanlibed e sikandan diye te Hirusalim, wey memaggulub naan de iya ka me etew te siyudad ne egkengaggale. Sika ka mahulub ne narineg niyu kuntee. 46 Ne kuntee, si Sulumun e ka Hari, 47 wey nangendiyad te ki Hari Dabid ka langun ne upisyal eyew egpakita te pegtahud dan kandin. Ne migkahiyan dan e si Dabid, ‘Ka Manama nu ka eggimu ki Sulumun ne egmabantug pad keykew wey egbulig kandin eyew meupiya pad ka peghari din du te peghari nu.’ Ne mig-usengul si Dabid diye te hibatanan din wey insimba rin ka Manama 48 wey migpasalamat ne migkahi, ‘Sayeen ka, Magbebaye ne Manama ne Manama te Israil, su kuntee, inggimu nud ne Hari ka sabeka ne kabuhalan ku wey impasapen e pad ubag nikeykew te peghari din.’ ”

43 And Diyunatan answered, “It's not a good story! Sulumun has_been_made king by our(incl) master King Dabid. 44 He sent_ Sulumun _with Saduk, Natan, Binayas and his guards and they mounted him on the king's horse. 45 And there at the Gihun spring, the head of Sulumun was_poured_over with oil by Saduk and by Natan in_order that he becomes king. And they returned(pl) to Hirusalim, and the people of the city were very_noisy indeed for being_very_happy(pl). That's the noise that you(pl) can hear now. 46 And now, Sulumun (is) the king, 47 and all the officials went to King Dabid in_order to show their respect to_him. And they said to Dabid, ‘May your(sg) God make_ Sulumun _respected than you(sg) and help him so_that his kinging is better than your(sg) kinging.’ And Dabid bowed_low there on his lying_place and he worshiped God 48 and he gave_thanks saying, ‘May you(sg) be_praised, Lord God the God of Israil, for today, you(sg) made one of my descendants king and you(sg) allowed me to see/witness his kinging.’ ”

49 Ne dutu, nangelkel e te liyas ka langun ne mahaliyug ni Aduniyas, nanasindeg sikandan wey nenekegsuwey-suwey re ka namallahuy. 50 Ne naaldek e si Aduniyas ki Sulumun. Mig-aput sikandin diye te Balungbalung te Magbebaye ne Manama wey miggen-gen diye te me sungey-sungey te altar. 51 Ne duen e nakalalag ki Sulumun te egkaaldek kun si Aduniyas kandin wey diyad e sikandin te altar ka miggen-gen te me sungey-sungey. Igkeupii rin kun ne egsaad si Sulumun ne kene eggimatayan sikandin.

49 And then, all the visitors of Aduniyas trembled(pl) with dread, they stood(pl) and (they) ran(pl) away just dispersedly. 50 And Aduniyas was_afraid of Sulumun. He fled to the Tent of the Lord God and held the horns of the altar. 51 And there_was (someone who) told Sulumun that Aduniyas [reportedly] was_afraid of_him and he was there at the altar holding the horns(of it). He wanted Sulumun to promise not to kill him.

52 Ne migkahi si Sulumun, “Emun ke ware eggimuwen din ne mareet, kene ku sikandin eggilabetan. Piru ke egsupak sikandin keddi, egpeyimatayan ku iya sikandin.” 53 Nataman, impaangey e ni Hari Sulumun si Aduniyas diye te altar. Pegginguma rin, miglangkeb e sikandin diye te tangkaan ni Hari Sulumun, wey ingkahiyan e sikandin te Hari, “Uli kad e diye te baley nu.”

52 And Sulumun said, “If he's doing nothing bad, I won't interfere_with him. But if he opposes me, I will_ indeed _have_him_killed.” 53 Then, King Sulumun had_ Aduniyas _brought from the altar. When_ he _arrived, he laid_prostrate there in front of King Sulumun, and he was_told_by the king, “Return_home(sg) there to your(pl) house.”

21 Te mahaan e egpatey si Dabid, impanpanayan din e ka anak din ne si Sulumun te migkahi, 2 “Te kene egkaluhey ne egpatey ad e. Ne kuntee sikeddiey e ka nabayungan wey ka narakeselan te inggimu rin. 6 Himuwa nu ke nekey ka eleg ne eggimuwen nu kandin, piru kene nud tahari ne egkabuyag pad sikandin human egpatey.

5 [xra][xrb]“You(sg) also know what_ Huwab the child of Siruya _did to_me. He killed the two leaders of the soldiers of Israil Abnir child of Nir, and Amasa child of Hitir. Piru te pegtupang din te Weyig ne Hurdan eyew egpakigkita keddiey, migsaad a kandin te ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama ne kene ku sikandin eggimatayan. 9 Ne kuntee, kene nu sikandin balahara ne kene egkalegparan. 10 Nataman, migpatey e si Dabid wey nekegdume e sikandan te me kaap-apuan din, wey diye sikandin isabal te Hirusalim ne siyudad din. 11 [xr]Mighari sikandin te Israil te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un; pitu ne leg-un diye te Hibrun, wey tatelu ne pulu wey tatelu (33) ne leg-un diye te Hirusalim. 12 [xr]Ne si Sulumun e ka mighari subal te amey rin ne si Dabid, wey amana ne maresen ka peghari din.

13 Sabeka ne aldew, miggendiye te ki Batsiba ne iney ni Sulumun, si Aduniyas ne anak ni Hagit. Ne mig-insaan sikandin ni Batsiba, “Keupianan ka innendini nu?”

31 Ne migkahiyan e si Binayas te Hari, “Himatayi nud iya si Huwab diye su sikan ma ka igkeupii rin. Migpalintutuu ka keddiey wey migkahi ka ne egtumanen a nikeykew. 43 Na, mania te ware nu tumana ka insaad nu te Magbebaye ne Manama wey ka insuhu ku keykew? 44 Nakataha ka te langun ne mareet ne inggimu nu diye te amey ku ne si Dabid. You(sg) will_be_punished by the Lord for your(sg) actions. 45 But I am_blessed by_him, and he will_make the kingdom of my father strong/powerful and without ending.”

10 Ne nahale ka Magbebaye te imbuyu ni Sulumun, 11 wey ingkahiyan din sikandin, “Puun su iyan nu ma imbuyu ka katuenan eyew eleg ka pegpangulu nu, kene ne sika se malayat ne umul, wey ke karatuan naa, wey ke karereetan naa te me kuntere nu, 12 igbehey ku keykew ka imbuyu nu. Ka pegpangandam ni Sulumun te peggimu te timplu

(2 Kru 2:1‑18)

(2 Chr 2:1‑18)

51 Ne due Hari te Tiru ne egngaranan ki Hiram ne naluhey e ne tala-alukuy ki Dabid. Purisu te nakanengneng e sikandin te mighari e si Sulumun subal te amey rin ne si Dabid, migsuhu e sikandin te me suluhuanen din diye ki Sulumun. 2 Ne impanahaan e degma ni Sulumun si Hiram: 3 “Nakanengneng ka ne ware nekeyimu te timplu ka amey ku ne si Dabid para te ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama rin, su layun de sikandin egpakig-ehet te me kuntere din ne nakalingut ne me nasud. Egpabulihan ku sikandan te me etew ku, wey egbayaran ku sikandan te minsan nekey ne igkeupii nu ne bayad su nakanengneng ka ne warad iya etew ku ne egpekeiling kandan te egpameled te kayu.”

Therefore when he became_aware that Sulumun was_kinging replacing his father Dabid, he commanded_ his servants _to_go to Sulumun. 2 And Sulumun also had_ Hiram _informed: 3 “You(sg) know that my father Dabid wasn't able_to_make a temple for the name of the Lord his God, because he was just always fighting_against his enemies surrounding nations. And then, they (were) indeed defeated by him from the help of the Lord. 4 But now/today the Lord my God has_given my kingdom peace. I have no_more enemies (from) anywhere or destruction/disaster. 5 [xr]That's why I am making a temple for name of the Lord my God, like what_ he _promised to my father Dabid saying, ‘Your(sg) child who_ I _will_replace on your(sg) throne (is) the (one who) will_make a temple for me.’ 6 So command(sg) [embarrassedly] your(sg) Sidunihanons in_order that I be_helped_by felling(pl) cedar trees there in Libanun. They will_be_helped by my people, and I will_pay them whatever is your(sg) desired payment because you(sg) know that there's_none among my people like them at felling/cutting tree(s).”

7 Te nahuhuran e si Hiram te lalag ni Sulumun, amana sikandin nahale wey migkahi, “Egdayanen ka Magbebaye ne Manama te seini ne aldew su imbehayan din si Dabid te matagseb ne anak eyew egsubal kandin eghari te dakel ne nasud!” 8 Ne impanahaan e degma ni Hiram si Sulumun te miggenendue, “Narineg kud ka lalag nu para keddi, wey andam a ne eggimu te igkeupii nu meyitenged te sidar wey sipris. 9 Igpatupang te me etew ku ka me geed ligkat te me bubungan te Libanun peendiye te Dahat ne Miditiranyu, wey eggimuwen dan seini ne gakit eyew eglawang sikandan peendiye te igkeupii nu ne eglimuran. Ne diye, egpangekaran dan e seini eyew eg-angayen e degma te me etew nu. Ne iyan ku re igkeupii ne egbehayan nu te egkakeen ka me etew ku kayi te palasyu ku.”

In-uney re ka me liggid wey ka me ihi diye te me sungkaleg. 33 Iling ded te me liggid te karwahi ka me liggid te papinnuuwan te pelenggana. Neneelin ne burunsi ka me ihi, me tubu, me rayus, wey me yantas. 34 Ne tagse papinnuuwan te pelenggana, due hep-at ne suley, sabeka te tagse pikungan, wey in-uney re iya man-e seini diye te papinnuuwan te pelenggana. 35 Ne diye te ampew te tagse papinnuuwan te pelenggana, due bibig ne subla te me sengerangew se kaluag. Ka me suley wey me alabat, in-uney re iya diye te lawa te papinnuuwan te pelenggana. 36 Impandayrayanan te impangulit ne me kirubin, me liyun, wey me palmira ka me suley wey me alabat te me papinnuuwan te pelenggana. Indayrayanan ka minsan hendei ne egkaayun pad. Impalingutan man-e seini te impangulit ne me bulak. 37 Ne iling naa due ka peggimu ni Hiram te sapulu ne papinnuuwan te pelenggana. Nenekeg-iling ka karakel wey ka ulaula te langun.

27 And Hiram also made ten bronze sitting_places for basin(s). The length of each one (was) two meters, the width (was) two meters, and the height (was) one and a half meter. 28 And the making of the sitting_places of the basin(s) (were) like this: each one had four corners, and they were walled(pl)_with 29 engravings of the lions, male cows, and cherubim. There_were also engraved flowers there near the top and bottom of the face(s) of lions and male cows. 30 And each sitting_place of basin(s), was_wheeled with bronze and the axle of wheel(s) (were) just bronze also. And each corner was_braced with bronze that's decorated with flowers. 31 In the inside of the sitting_place_of_the_basin, there's a support for the basin that has circle/round hole. It's extended from the sitting_place_of_the_basin for one and half feet and it's also decorated with engravings. 32 And the four wheels of the sitting_place of the basin that's about two feet and a half were attached below the wall. The wheels and the axles were_connected to the posts. 33 The wheels of the sitting_place of the basin were_ just _the_same_as the wheels of the cart/chariot. And the axles, the pipes, the spokes, and the rims were all bronze. 34 And each sitting_place of the basin, had four braces, one in each corner, and these were_just_connected to the sitting_place of the basin. 35 And there_on top of the sitting_place of the basin, there_was a lip/rim/border that's about more than a hand_span wide/high. The braces and walls, were_ just indeed _connected to the body of the sitting_place of the basin. 36 The braces and the walls of the sitting_places of the basin were_decorated with engraved cherubims, lions, and palm (trees). Everywhere that can still be_decorated was_decorated. These were_ also _encircled with engraved flowers. 37 And that's how Hiram made the ten sitting_places of the basin. The size and the shape (LIT face) of all were_the_same_as_each_other.

38 [xr]Ne migpangimu e man-e si Hiram te sapulu ne pelenggana ne burunsi—sabeka ne pelenggana te tagse sabeka degma ne papinnuuwan. Daruwa ne mitrus ka kaluag te nekeglimang ne bibig te pelenggana, wey egkatahuan seini te daruwa ne gatus (200) ne gelun ne weyig. 39 Impasasindeg din ka me papinnuuwan te pelenggana, lalimma ka dapit te igkakawanan te timplu, wey lalimma degma dapit te igkahibang te timplu. Ne diye din ipasasindeg dapit te igkakawanan te timplu ka limuranan te weyig ne burunsi ne egngaranan te Dahat, elat-elat te igkakawanan ne balabalahan wey te igsile. 40 Miggimu degma si Huram te kuren puun te basak, me pala, wey me yahung.

38 [xr]And Hiram also made ten bronze basins—one basin also for each one sitting_place. The width of the opposite lips of the basin was two meters, and it could have two hundred (200) gallon_containers of water stored_in_it. 39 He got_ the sitting_places of the basins _stood_up, five there on the right of the temple, and five also there on the left of the temple. And he got_ the bronze collecting_place of water that is called Sea _stood_up there at the right_side of the temple, between south and east. 40 Huram also made pots from mud, shovels, and bowls.

Neimpusan ded iya ni Huram ka langun ne impeyimu ni Sulumun te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama.

Huram indeed completed all that_ Sulumun _wanted_made for the temple of the Lord God.

Ka listaan te me kasangkapan diye te timplu

The list of utensils there in the temple

(2 Kru 4:11–5:1)

(2 Chr 4:11–5:1)

Ne seini langun ka neyimu ni Huram:41 ka daruwa ne sungkaleg; ka daruwa ne pupul te me sungkaleg ne egpekeiling te yahung; ka daruwa ne inlubid ne keddina ne indayan-dayan diye te pupul te me sungkaleg; 42 ka hep-at ne gatus (400) ne me prutas ne egngaranan te granada ne burunsi ne impamitin te daruwa ne dangdang diye te inlubid ne keddina ne intahu diye te pupul te me sungkaleg; 43 ka sapulu ne egpeunturan, wey ka sapulu ne me pelenggana ne igmapinuu; 44 ka tahuanan te weyig ne egngaranan te Dahat wey ka sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne larawan te turu ne baka ne egpeunturan te tahuanan te weyig; 45 ka me kuren ne inggimu puun te tane, ka me pala, wey me yahung.

And this is all that_ Huram _made:41 two posts; two end_points of the posts like the bowls; two intertwined chains decorated at the end_point of the posts; 42 the four hundred (400) bronze like the pomegranate fruits hanged on the two lines there on the intertwined chains that were put at the end_point of the posts; 43 the ten bases, and the ten basins caused_to_be_seated(pl); 44 the water container that's called Sea and the twelve (12) statues of male cow that were_the_mounting_place of the container of water; 45 the pots, shovels, and bowls.

Impasinawan ka langun ne burunsi ne kasangkapan te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne impangimu ni Hiram para ki Hari Sulumun.46 Diye seini ipeyimu te Hari te napu te Hurdan ne himuwanan te kuren ne tane diye te eletanan te Sukut wey Saritan. 47 Warad e ipatimbang ni Hari Sulumun ka langun ne kasangkapan puun su amana seini ne susuluhi. Sikan naa ka ware iya nanengnengi ke pila ne kilu ka burunsi ka nahamit langun.

All the bronze equipments of the temple of the Lord God (were)_made_shiny that Hiram made for King Sulumun.46 The king caused_it_to_be_made there in the valley of Hurdan where pots made of soil were_made there at the boundary of Sukut and Saritan. 47 King Sulumun no_longer got_ all the utensils _weighed because there were extremely many. That's why (it) was not found out how many kilos of all bronze that's used.

48 [xra][xrb]Ne migpeyimu man-e si Sulumun te seini ne me kasangkapan para te timplu te Magbebaye: bulawan ne altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen; ka bulawan ne lamisa ne eg-unturan te paan ne ighalad diye te tangkaan te Manama; 49 [xr]ka me tahuanan te sulu ne neelin ne bulawan ne diye te tangkaan te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng. Lalimma ka dapit te igkakawanan, wey lalimma degma ka dapit te igkahibang; ka indayan-dayan ne neelin ne bulawan ne me bulak, me sulu, wey me sipit; 50 ka me pakawan, ka igmanempug te pebilu te sulu, ka me pelenggana, ka me tahuanan te insinsu, ka me tahuanan te baha ne neelin ne bulawan. Bulawan ded man-e ka me bisagra te gumawan te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng, wey ka me bisagre en iya te me gumawan te timplu.

48 [xra][xrb]And these (were) all the utensils there in the temple that Sulumun got_made: gold altar to put_on a burning_offering; gold table to put_on the bread to offer there in front of God; 49 [xr]the containers/holders of lamp(s) that were pure gold that were there in front of the Very Holy Room. The (ones) there on the right (were) five, and the (ones) also there on the left (were) five; the pure gold flowers, lamps, and clips made_as_decorations; 50 the cups, the cutters for wick(s) of lamp(s), the basins, the containers of incense, and containers of embers which were pure gold. The hinges of the doorways of the Very Holy Room, and the hinges of the doorways of the temple itself (were) just also gold.

51 [xr]Ne neimpusan ded iya ni Hari Sulumun ka pegpasasindeg te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne impanines e ni Sulumun diye te sinabeng ne tinesanan te timplu te Magbebaye ka me kasangkapan ne inhalad te amey rin ne si Dabid ne iyan ka pelata, ka bulawan, wey ka duma pad ne me kasangkapan.

51 [xr]And king Sulumun indeed finished to erect the temple of the Lord God. And Sulumun kept the utensils that his father Dabid had offered such as silver, gold, and other materials in the storing_place in the temple of the Lord.

Ka peg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan diye te timplu

The bringing of the Container of the Agreement there to the temple

(2 Kru 5:2–6:2)

(2 Chr 5:2–6:2)

81 [xr]Ne impeumew ni Hari Sulumun diye te kandin diye te Hirusalim ka me pangulu te me matig-Israil, wey ka me pangulu te me pamilya eyew eg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te timplu puun te Siyudad ni Dabid, ne egngaranan degma te Siyun. 2 [xr]Purisu, nanlibulung e sikandan langun diye ki Hari Sulumun te timpu te Sahakeen te me Balungbalung te igkapitu ne bulan ne egngaranan te Itanim.[fn] 3 Te nalibulung e ka me pangulu te me matig-Israil, intitiang e te me talagpanubad ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye, 4 wey in-uuyan dan e diye te timplu. Ne in-uuyan dan degma ka Balungbalung ne Temuwanan wey ka langun ne kasangkapan ne intahu diye. 5 Ne si Hari Sulumun wey ka langun ne keet-etawan te Israil ne miglibulung diye te tangkaan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan, migpanubad te susuluhi amana ne karniru wey me baka ne kenad e egkaseel.

81 [xr]And Sulumun summoned to him there in Hirusalim the leaders of the (ones) from_Israil, the leaders of the families in_order to bring the Container of the Lord God to the temple from the City of Dabid, which is also called Siyun. 2 [xr]Therefore, all of them gathered together there to king Sulumun at the time of the Feast of the Tents on the seventh month named Itanim.[fn] 3 When the leaders of Israil were gathered together, the sacrificers and the Libitas carried_on_shoulder the Container of the Agreement of the Lord, 4 and brought (it) there in the temple. They also brought the Tent of Meeting and all the utensils that were put in there. 5 And king Sulumun and all the people of Israil that gathered there in front of the Container of the Agreement, sacrificed very many sheep and cows that couldn't be_counted.

6 Ne in-uyan e te me talagpanubad ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye diye te ledled te timplu, diye te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng te timplu. Ne intahu dan e seini diye te diralem te nekegtupu ne impabekal ne me pakpak te daruwa ne kirubin. 7 Impabekad ka me pakpak te daruwa ne kirubin, sikan naa ka nariralem kayi ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan lagkes ka me yayunganan. 8 Mallayat ka me yayunganan wey nakita ka pupul kayi te me etew ne migsasindeg diye te tangkaan te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng. Piru kene de iya man-e seini egkiteen diye te lihawangan. Ne diye ded iya seini taman kuntee. 9 [xr]Ware lein ne tahu te Tahuanan te Kasabutan angin e te daruwa ne malumpayag ne me batu ne intahu ni Muwisis te diye sikandin te bubungan ne Sinay[fn] ka inged ne miggimu ka Magbebaye te kasabutan te me matig-Israil te peglihawang dan te inged ne Ihiptu.

6 And the sacrificers brought the Container of the Covenant of the Lord God there in the inner_part of the temple, there in the Very Holy Room of the temple. And they kept it there under the joint wings of the two cherubims spreading_over. 7 The wings of the two cherubims were caused_to_spread_over, that's why the Container of the Agreement including the carrying_poles were under its shed. 8 The carrying_poles were long and their ends could_be_seen by people that were_standing there in front of the Very Holy Room. But they could_ not _be_seen from outside. And it was there until now. 9 [xr]Nothing else was inside the Container of the Agreement except two flat stones that Muwisis put in when he was at the mountain of Sinay[fn] the place where the Lord made an agreement with the (ones) from_Israil on their coming_out of place of Ihiptu.

10 [xr]Te miglihawang e te timplu ka me talagpanubad, sahuhune ne napenu te gapun ka timplu. 11 Purisu, warad nakapabulus ka himu te me talagpanubad diye te timplu tenged te gapun, su napenu ma te katelesan te Magbebaye ka timplu rin. 12 [xr]Ne mig-ampu e si Sulumun ne migkahi,

10 [xr]When the sacrificers exited the temple, suddenly the temple was_filled with cloud. 11 Therefore, the work of the sacrificers did_ not _continue in the temple due to the cloud, for the splendor of the Lord filled his temple. 12 [xr]And Sulumun prayed saying,

“He Magbebaye ne Manama, intahu nu ka aldew diye te langit,

“Oh Lord God, you(sg) put the sun there in the sky,

piru migkahi ka ne duen ka mig-ugpe te makepal ne gapun.[fn]

but you(sg) said that you(sg) live there in the thick cloud.[fn]

13 Piru inggimuwan ku sikeykew te tetelesi ne timplu

13 But I made for you(sg) a very_beautiful temple

ne eg-ugpaan nu te ware egtamanan.”

where_ you(sg) _live without ending.”

Ka pegpakiglalag ni Sulumun te me etew

The speaking by Sulumun with the people

(2 Kru 6:3‑11)

(2 Chr 6:3‑11)

14 Ne taheed te migmanasindeg ka me etew te Israil, migtangke si Hari Sulumun kandan wey impanalanginan din e sikandan. 15 Migkahi sikandin, “Egdayanen ka Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil ne migtuman te insaad din te amey ku ne si Dabid. Migkahi sikandin dengan, 16 [xr]‘Puun te timpu ne impalihawang ku ka keet-etawan ku puun te Ihiptu, ware siyudad ne in-alam ku te tane te me Israilita ne egpasasindehan ku te timplu eyew egkabantug a. Piru in-alam ku si Dabid eyew egpangulu te keet-etawan ku ne me matig-Israil.’ ”

14 And while the people of Israil stood, king Sulumun turned_to_face them and he blessed them. 15 He said, “Praised be the Lord, the God of Israil who fulfilled his promise to my father Dabid. He said long_ago, 16 [xr]‘From the time that I caused_ my people _to_come_out of Ihiptu, I did not choose any city in the land of the Israelites where I will_erect my temple so_that I will_be_famous. But I have chosen Dabid in_order to lead my people the (ones) from_Israil.’ ”

17 [xr]Ne migpabulus si Sulumun ka migkahi, “Amana egkeupian ka amey ku ne si Dabid ne egpasasindeg te timplu eyew te pegbantug te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil. 18 Piru ingkahiyan sikandin te Magbebaye, ‘Meupiya te egkeup-upian ka ne egpasasindeg te timplu eyew te pegbantug te ngaran ku. 19 [xr]Piru kene ne sikeykew ka egpasasindeg te timplu, ke kene ka anak nu ne lukes ka egpakapasasindeg kayi eyew egkabantug a.’

17 [xr]And Sulumun continued saying, “My father Dabid truly desired to put_up a temple to glorify the Lord, the God of Israil. 18 But the Lord said to him, ‘Good that you(sg) desired to put_up a temple to glorify my name. 19 [xr]But you(sg) (are) not the (one who) will_put_up my temple, but rather your(sg) male child can_cause_ it _to_stand in_order (that) I be_honored.’

20 “Ne intuman iya te Magbebaye ka insaad din su neyimu e ma ne Hari te Israil subal te amey ku ne si Dabid, sumale te insaad te Magbebaye. Ne kuntee napasasindeg ku iya ka timplu eyew te pegbantug te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil. 21 Ne inteilan kud te egtahuan diye te timplu ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne inggimu rin duma te me kaap-apuan ta te timpu te impalihawang din sikandan puun te Ihiptu.”

20 “And the Lord truly fulfilled his promise because I became a king of Israil replacing my father Dabid, according to the promise of the Lord. And now/today I have erected indeed the temple in_order to glorify the Lord, the God of Israil. 21 And I arranged that the Container of the Agreement of the Lord that he made with our(incl) ancestors at the time when he caused_ them _to_exit from Ihiptu to_be_put there in the temple.”

Ka peg-ampu ni Sulumun

The praying by Sulumun

(2 Kru 6:12‑42)

(2 Chr 6:12‑42)

22 Ne diye te tangkaan te me matig-Israil, migsasindeg si Sulumun diye te tangkaan te altar te Magbebaye wey ingkayew rin ka me belad din. 23 Mig-ampu sikandin, “He Magbebaye, ne Manama te Israil, ware manama ne iling keykew diye te langit ne diye te ampew wey ke kayi naa te tane ne kayi te diralem. Intuman nu ka kasabutan nu wey impapitew nu ka geyinawa nu ne kene egkabalbalawan diye te me suluhuanen nu ne migpamakey keykew te intiru ne pusung dan. 24 Intuman nu ka insaad nu te suluhuanen nu ne si Dabid ne amey ku. Intuman nu ka sika ne lalag nu te seini ne aldew. 25 [xr]Ne kuntee, Magbebaye, ne Manama te Israil, tumana nu ka insaad nu te suluhuanen nu ne si Dabid ne amey ku. Migkahi ka, ‘Kene egkataman ka kabuhalan nu ne eghari te Israil ke egmatinumanen sikandan keddi iling te inggimu nu.’ 26 Purisu, kuntee, he Manama te Israil, tumana nu ka insaad nu te suluhuanen nu ne si Dabid ne amey ku.

22 And there in front of the (ones) from_Israil, Sulumun stood there in front of the altar of the Lord and raised his hands/arms. 23 And he prayed, “Oh Lord, the God of Israil, no God like you(sg) there in heaven that's there above or here in the land that's here below. You(sg) obeyed your(sg) agreement and showed your(sg) unchangeable love to your(sg) servants who served you(sg) in their whole hearts. 24 You(sg) fulfilled what_ you(sg) _promised to your(sg) servant Dabid my father. You(sg) fulfilled(sg) that your(sg) word on this day. 25 [xr]And now/today, Lord, the God of Israil, fulfill(sg) what_ you(sg) _promised to your(sg) servant Dabid who was my father. You(sg) said, ‘Your(sg) descendants won't end ruling in Israil if they are_faithful to me like you(sg) did.’ 26 Therefore, now, oh God of Israil, fulfill(sg) what_ you(sg) _promised to your(sg) servant Dabid my father.

27 [xr]“Piru eg-ugpe ke naa Manama kayi te kalibutan? Ne minsan ka langit ne titikangi kene ma ne eleg ne eg-ugpaan nu, iyan naan pa iya seini se timplu ne impasasindeg ku! 28 Piru pammineha nu ubag seini se peg-ampu te suluhuanen nu wey ka pegpeyid-u-hid-u rin, he Manama ku. Pammineha nu ka pegpangumew wey peg-ampu te suluhuanen nu te seini ne aldew, 29 [xr]wey tamengi nu ubag te aldew wey marusilem seini se timplu, ka baley ne ingkahi nu ne kayi egbantuha ka ngaran nu. Pammineha nu ubag ka peg-ampu te suluhuanen nu ne egtangke kayi te timplu. 30 Pammineha nu ubag ka pegpeyid-u-hid-u ku te suluhuanen nu wey te keet-etawan nu ne me matig-Israil ke eg-ampu key ne egtangke kayi te timplu. Pammineha key nikeykew due te langit ne ugpaan nu wey pasayluwa key te me sale ney.

27 [xr]“But God would_ you(sg) _live here in the world? And even the heaven which is very_high won't be enough for you(sg) to live_in, how much more is this temple that I got_built! 28 But listen(pl) please to this praying of your(sg) servant and his plea, oh my God. Listen(sg) to the calling and praying of your(sg) servant this day, 29 [xr]and please guard(sg) [embarrassedly] this temple in a day and in the night, the house that_ you(sg) _said that_ your(sg) name _will_be_made_great here. Please listen(sg) to the praying of your(sg) servant that facing here in temple. 30 Listen(sg) please on my plea as your(sg) servant and of your(sg) people the (ones) from_Israil if we(excl) pray facing here in the temple. 31 “Ke egbayungan ka sabeka ne etew ne nakasale te duma rin, wey eggendini sikandin te altar ne kayi te timplu eyew egpahunlibet ne ware sale din, 32 pammineha nu sikandin due te langit wey hukumi nu sikandan se daruwa—ka migbayung wey ka imbayungan. Legpari nu ka nakasale tenged te mareet ne neyimu rin, wey hukumi nu ne ware sale seeye se ware neyimu ne mareet.

31 “If one person is_accused that (he/she) sinned_against his/her companion, and he/she comes_here to the altar here in the temple in_order to_make_an_oath that he/she has_no sin, 32 listen(sg) him there in heaven/sky and judge(sg) the two of them—the accuser and the one_that_has_been_accused. Punish(sg) the (one who) sinned because of the bad_act that he did, and judge the_(one) that don't_have bad act as no sin.

33 “Ne emun ke egkatalu ka keet-etawan nu ne me matig-Israil te me kuntere dan tenged te nakasale sikandan keykew, wey eglibed sikandan keykew, wey eg-ampu wey egpeyid-u-hid-u keykew kayi te timplu, 34 pammineha nu sikandan due te langit. 33 “And if your(sg) people the (ones) from_Israil are_defeated by their enemies due to they sinned_against you(sg), and they return to_you(sg), and pray and plead to_you(sg) here in the temple, 34 listen(sg) to_them there in heaven/sky. 37 “Ke due bitil te inged dan wey ke duen naa karereetan ne egginguma kandan, ke egkaddeetan naa se me pinamula, ke duen naa me talangas wey me uled-uled naa ne egkeen te me pinamula, wey ke duen naa kuntere ne eglusud te me siyudad dan, wey ke duen naa kasakitan wey ke duen naa dalu ne egginguma kandan, 38 ke eg-ampu wey ke egpeyid-u-hid-u sikandan keykew, pammineha nu sikandan. Ke in-ila ran ne tenged te sale dan ne migginguma ka me keyirapan wey kalaggew, wey ingkayew ran ka me belad dan ne migtangke kayi te timplu, 39 pammineha nu sikandan due te langit ne ugpaan nu. 37 “If there's a famine of their place or there_is destruction that comes to them, if the crops go_bad(pl), or there_are locust(s) or insect(s) that eat crops, or if there_are enemy(s) that invade their cities, or if there_is pain or if there_is sickness that comes_to them, 38 if they pray and plead to_you(sg), listen(sg) to_them. If they recognize that due to their sin the difficulties and sadness came, and they raise their hands facing the temple here, 39 listen(sg) to_them there in heaven/sky that's your(sg) living_place. The turning_away of Sulumun from God

111 [xr]Amana ne masulug ka lapu ne me malitan ne inggeyinawaan ni Sulumun. Ne ka me asawa rin iya ka nakapeinniyug kandin te Manama. 4 Te nabuyag e si Sulumun, napanulu e sikandin te me asawa rin ne egsimba te me diyus-diyus dan. Warad nasabeka ka pusung din diye te Magbebaye ne Manama rin; kene ne iling te amey rin ne si Dabid. 5 Migsimbe e sikandin ki Astarut, ka diyus-diyus te me Sidunihanen, wey ki Milkum, ka subla ne malindit ne diyus-diyus te me matig-Amun. 6 Mareet naan de iya ka inggimu ni Sulumun diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey ware sikandin migmatinumanen te Manama. Ware sikandin mig-iling te amey rin ne si Dabid. 7 Ne diye te bubungan dapit te igsile te Hirusalim, miggimu si Sulumun te panubaran para ki Kimus, ka subla ne malindit ne diyus-diyus te me matig-Muwab, wey ki Muluk, ka subla ne malindit ne diyus-diyus te me matig-Amun. 8 Ne inggimuwan din degma te me panubaran ka langun ne lapu ne me asawa rin, eyew diye sikandan egpanutung te insinsu wey egpanubad te me diyus-diyus dan.

9 Purisu, nabelu e ka Magbebaye ne Manama ki Sulumun su mig-inniyuhan din man e ka Manama te Israil ne migpakita kandin te kararuwa,[fn] 10 wey migpaney-paney kandin ne kene egsimba te me diyus-diyus. Ware tumana ni Sulumun ka insuhu kandin te Magbebaye ne Manama. 11 Sikan naa ka ingkahiyan e si Sulumun te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Puun su migsuman-suman ka ne kene egtuman te kasabutan ku keykew, wey ware nu tumana ka me balaud ku ne igpatuman ku keykew, eggawien kud ka migharian puun keykew wey igbehey kud seini te upisyal nu. 12 Piru tenged ki Dabid ne amey nu, kene ku seini eggimuwen taheed te manekal ke pad. Ka me kuntere ni Sulumun

The enemies of Sulumun

14 Ne impakuntere e te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Sulumun si Hadad ne Idumihanen. Kabuhalan sikandin te Hari te Idum. 15 Su dengan te timpu ne migbubunu si Dabid te me matig-Idum, migtakereg si Huwab ne pangulu te me sundalu eyew eglebeng te migpatey ne me sundalu. Ne te seeye ne timpu, impeyimatayan e ni Dabid ka langun ne lukes diye te Idum.[fn] 16 Su mig-uugpe mam pad si Huwab diye duma te me Israilita te hen-em ne bulan, taman te naamin dan e neyimatayi ka langun ne lukes diye te Idum. 17 Ware neyimatayi si Hadad su migpallahuy sikandin diye te Ihiptu duma te me Idumihanen ne upisyal te amey rin. Deisek pad si Hadad te seeye ne timpu. 18 Te nekeume e sikandan diye te Midiyan puun te Idum, migleus e sikandan diye te Paran. Ne migdurume e sikandan te me etew puun te Paran peendiye ki Paraun ne Hari te Ihiptu, wey imbehayan e sikandan te baley, egkakeen, wey tane. 19 Amana ikeupii te Hari te Ihiptu si Hadad. Purisu impaasawaan e sikandin te Hari te ipag din ne hari ni Rayna Tapinis. 20 Nataman, naberes e ka asawa ni Hadad, wey inlesutan e te lukes ne ingngaranan ki Ginubat. Ne ka rayna ka miglitan kandin diye te palasyu te Hari te Ihiptu. Ne diyad en iya mig-ugpe si Ginubat duma te me anak te Hari.

14 And the Lord God put_ Hadad the Idumihanon _against Sulumun. He (was) a descendant of the king of Idum. 15 Because long_ago when Dabid fighting the (ones) from_Idum, Huwab the leader of soldiers ascended in_order to bury dead soldiers. And at that time, Dabid got_ all the males there in Idum _killed.[fn] 16 Because Huwab still remained there along_with some of the Israilitas for six months, until they finished killing all the males there in Idum. 17 Hadad wasn't killed because he fled to Ihiptu along_with some Idumihanons that (were) officials of his father. Hadad was just small at that time. 18 When they arrived there at Midiyan coming_from Idum, they went to Paran. And they took_with_them people from Paran to Pharaoh the king of Ihiptu, and they were_given a house, food, and land. 19 King Pharaoh greatly liked Hadad. That's why the king caused_ him _to_marry_off his sister-in-law the younger_sibling of Queen Tapinis. 20 Then, the spouse of Hadad became_pregnant, and she bore a male that was_named Ginubat. And the queen (was) the (one who) raised him there in the palace of the king of Ihiptu. And Ginubat lived there indeed along_with the children of the king.

21 Nataman, duen e guhuren ne migpatey e si Dabid wey nekegdume e sikandin te me kaap-apuan din, wey si Huwab ne pangulu te me sundalu. Ne ingkahiyan e ni Hadad ka Hari te Ihiptu, “Peulia ad ubag diye te inged ku.”

21 Then, there_were stories that Dabid died and he accompanied his ancestors, and Huwab the leader of soldiers had_died. And the king of Ihiptu was_told by Hadad, “Send_ me _home [please] there to my place.”

22 Piru ingkahiyan sikandin te Hari, “Mania? Due ware ku ikabehey keykew—sikan naa ka eg-uli kad e diye te inged nu?”

22 But the king said to_him, “Why? Is there (something) I haven't given you(sg)—that's why you(sg) will_go_home there to your(sg) place?”

23 Ne impakuntere e degma te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Sulumun si Risun ne anak ni Ilyada. Migpallahuy si Risun puun te ahalen din ne si Hadadisir ne Hari te Suba. 24 Ne inlibulung din e ka me etew wey miggimu e sikandin te punduk te me ribildi, wey sikandin ka neyimu ne pangulu. Te natalu e ni Dabid ka me sundalu ni Hadadisir, miggendiyad si Risun te Damasku duma te me etew rin, wey diyad e sikandan mig-ugpe. Ne inggimu e sikandin ne Hari te me etew rin te siyudad te Damasku. 25 Neyimu si Risun ne Hari te Sirya, wey neyimu ne kuntere te Israil taman te manekal pad si Sulumun. 23 And God put Risun the child of Ilyada against Sulumun also. Ka saad te Manama ki Rihubuwam

26 Ne duen pad man-e etew ne migkuntere ki Hari Sulumun ne iyan si Hirubuwam ne sabeka te me upisyal rin. Anak sikandin ni Nibat ne matig-Sirida ne sakup te Ipraim. Sikan naa ka impiyalan din e sikandin te langun ne migtrabahu diye te me ugpaan te kabuhalan enni Ipraim wey Manasis ne me anak ni Husi. 29 Sabeka ne aldew, miggipanew si Hirubuwam puun te Hirusalim. Warad e mig-ikul si Sulumun te igkeupii ku—ware miggimu sikandin te igkeele ku wey ware din e tumana ka me balaud ku wey ka me suhu ku. Kene ne iling sikandin te amey rin ne si Dabid. 34 Piru kene ku eggawien ka intiru ne migharian puun kandin—igpahari ku red sikandin taman te egpatey e. Eggimuwen ku seini tenged te suluhuanen ku ne si Dabid, ka in-alam ku ne matinumanen te me balaud ku wey te me suhu ku. 35 Piru eggawien kud ka dakel ne baad te migharian puun te anak din, wey igbehey ku keykew ka sapulu ne kabuhalan ne egpuun te me anak ni Hakub. 36 Piru egbehayan ku red te sabeka ne kabuhalan ne egpuun te me anak ni Hakub ka anak ni Sulumun eyew kene ded egkaawaan te kabuhalan ka suluhuanen ku ne si Dabid ne eghari te Hirusalim, ka siyudad ne in-alam ku eyew egsimbaan keddi. 37 Ne sikeykew Hirubuwam, eggimuwen ku sikeykew ne Hari te Israil, wey egmandu ka te langun ne inged ne igkeupii nu ne egmanduan. 38 Ne emun ke eg-iling ka ki Dabid ne egtuman te me suhu ku, wey eg-ikul te egkeupii ku, wey eggimu te igkeele ku, egdumaan ku iya sikeykew. Eggimuwen ku sikeykew ne Hari te Israil. Ne iling te inggimu ku ki Dabid, ka me kabuhalan nu iya degma ka eghari subal keykew te malayat ne timpu. 39 Ne tenged te sale ni Sulumun, eglegparan ku ka me kabuhalan ni Dabid, piru kene ne taman te ware egtamanan.’ ”

26 And there_was still also man who go_against King Sulumun whose name is Hirubuwam one of his officers. Hirubuwam was a child of Nibat from_Sirida under_the_jurisdiction of Ipraim. His mother was a widow named Siruwa. 27 And this was the beginning of his opposing the king: Sulumun cause_to_make Milu,[fn] and got_ the tall and thick stone fence of the City of Dabid that his father _repaired. 28 Hirubuwam was a very knowledgeable/skilled young_man, and Sulumun saw that he (was) very hard-working. And there on the path, he met the prophet from_Silu named Ahiyas. 19 Sikan naa ka migdume en iya ka prupita ne matig-Huda te miglibed diye te baley te buyag ne prupita, wey migkeen wey mig-inum e sikandin. 20 Ne taheed te egkekeen sikandan, impanengneng te Magbebaye ne Manama ka buyag ne prupita, 21 wey miglalahan din e ka prupita ne matig-Huda, “Migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama te insupak nu sikandin wey ware nu tumana ka insuhu din keykew. 22 Miglibed ka wey migkeen ka kayi te inged ne impaney-paney te Magbebaye ne Manama keykew ne kene egkaayun ne egkeenan nu. 19 That's why the prophet from_Huda accompanied to return to the house of the old prophet, and he ate and drank. 20 And while they ate, the old prophet had_made_known by the Lord God, 21 and he spoke_to the prophet from_Huda, “The Lord God says that you(sg) went_against him and you(sg) didn't obey what_ he _commanded you(sg). 22 You(sg) returned and you(sg) ate here in the place that the Lord God warned you(sg) that it's not_possible that you(sg) eat_here. And from that, if you(sg) die, you(sg) won't be buried there at the burial_place of your(sg) ancestors.”

23 Te nekeimpus e sikandan ka migkeen wey mig-inum, insakangan e te buyag ne prupita ka asnu eyew eg-unturan te prupita ne matig-Huda ne ingginggat din. 24 Te egpahundalan e sikandin, insinug-ung e sikandin te liyun wey innimatayan e sikandin. Ne diye de iya te dalan nekeyibat ka lawa rin, ne diye de iya degma migsasindeg ka asnu wey ka liyun te dulug te lawa rin. 25 Ne due me etew ne miglihad wey nakakita te minatey diye te dalan wey te liyun ne migsasindeg diye te dulug kayi. Migleus e sikandan diye te Bitil, ka inged ne in-ugpaan te buyag ne prupita, wey impangguhud dan e ka nakita ran.

23 When they had_finished eating and drinking, the old prophet saddled the donkey so_that the prophet from_Huda that he had_invited (could) mount_it. 24 When he was_on_the_path already, he met a lion and he was_killed. And his body just lay there indeed on the path, and the donkey just stood there also and the lion beside his body. 25 And there_were people that passed and saw the corpse there on the path and the lion standing beside it. They continued_on to Bitil, the place that the old prophet lived, and they storied what_ they _had_seen.

26 Te nakatahe e ka buyag ne prupita te neyitabu, migkahi e sikandin, “Sika ka prupita ne migsupak te suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama. Sikan naa ka impalusuran sikandin te Magbebaye te liyun eyew eggimatey kandin su sika iya ka inlalag din kandin.” 27 Ne ingkahiyan din e ka me anak din, “Sakangi niyu ka asnu ne eg-unturan ku.” Ne insakangan dan en iya ka asnu. 28 Ne miggipanew e sikandin wey nakita rin en iya ka lawa te prupita ne nekeyibat diye te dalan, wey ka asnu wey liyun ne migsasindeg diye te dulug kayi. Ware ma mule keena te liyun ka minatey wey ke inggimatayan naa ka asnu. 29 Ne inggenat e te buyag ne prupita ka minatey, indulan din seini te asnu wey in-uyan din e te eglibed diye te Bitil eyew egdamahen dan pad human iglebeng. 30 Nataman, inlebeng din e ka minatey diye te lebenganan te kaap-apuan din, wey migsinehew sikandin wey ka me anak din te migkahi, “Keyid-u naan de iya ki suled di!” 31 Pegkeimpus te eglebeng, ingkahiyan e te prupita ka me anak din, “Emun egpatey ad e, kayi e re nikaniyu ilebeng wey ipewulid niyu ka lawa ku te lawa rin. 32 Su egkatuman iya ka me guhuren ne impalalag te Magbebaye ne Manama kandin meyitenged te altar diye te Bitil, wey te langun ne me panubaran diye te me bubungan te inged te Samarya.”

26 When the old prophet knew about what_had_happened, he said, “That's the prophet that went_against the command of the Lord God. That's why the Lord cause_to_attack him with lion in_order to kill him because that indeed is_what_ he _said to_him.” 27 And he told his children, “Saddle(pl) the donkey that I ride.” And they indeed saddled the donkey. 28 And he went and he saw the body of the prophet indeed lying there on the path, and the donkey and lion that were_standing there beside it. The corpse indeed wasn't on_the_contrary eaten by the lion or the donkey killed. 29 And the old_prophet picked_up the corpse, he carried it to the donkey and he took it going_back to Bitil in_order_for them to_mourn_over before burying_it. 30 Then, he buried the corpse there in the burial_place of his ancestors, and he and his children cried saying, “How pity_full is my brother!” 31 After the burial, the prophet said to his children, “When I die, just bury me in this grave and lay(pl)_ my body _beside his body. 32 Because the stories that Lord God got_ him _to_tell about the altar there at Bitil, and at all the sacrificing_places there on the mountains of Samarya will_come_to_pass indeed.”

Ka subla ne dakel ne sale ni Hirubuwam

The biggest sin by Hirubuwam

33 Ne minsan pad iling e dutu ka neyitabu, ware inniyuhi te Hari te Israil ne si Hirubuwam ka mareet ne me himu rin. Migpabulus-bulus sikandin ka migpangalam te me talagpanubad puun te langun ne etew eyew egpamakey diye te me panubaran ne diye te me bubungan. Eggimuwen din ne talagpanubad ka minsan hentew ne egkeupian ne egkeyimu ne talagpanubad. 34 Ne seini ne himu ni Hirubuwam ka egpuunan ne nakasale ka kabuhalan din, wey migpuunan te karereetan wey pegkahuhus te migharian din.

33 And even though that happened, Hirubuwam the king of Israil didn't turn_from his evil actions/deeds. He continued choosing sacrificers from all people in_order to serve there on the sacrificing_places on the mountain. He made a sacrificer whoever wanted to become a sacrificer. 34 And this action by Hirubuwam is the reason that his descendants sinned, and the reason for the destruction and demolition of his kingdom.

Ka pegpatey te anak ni Hirubuwam

The death of a child of Hirubuwam

141 Te seeye ne timpu, migderalu si Abiyas ne anak ni Hari Hirubuwam. 2 Ne ingkahiyan ni Hirubuwam ka asawa rin, “Hendiye ke pa ubag te Silu ne in-ugpaan ni Ahiyas ne prupita. Sikandin ka migkahi ne sikeddi ka egkeyimu ne Hari te Israil. Kene ka peila te me etew ne sikeykew ka asawa ku. 3 Uyani nu sikandin te sapulu ne timman ne paan, me mamun ne mannipis, wey sabeka ne banga ne teneb. Insei nu naa sikandin ke nekey ka egkeyitabu te anak ta, wey eglalahan ka nikandin.”

141 At that time, Abiyas the child of King Hirubuwam was_sick. 2 And Hirubuwam told his spouse, “Go(sg) [embarrassedly] to Silu that's the living_place of Ahiyas the prophet. He (is) the (one who) told me that I would_become the king of Israil. Don't reveal to the people that you(sg) (are) my spouse/wife. 3 Bring(sg) him ten pieces of bread, thin cakes, and one jar of honey. Ask(sg) him what will_happen to our(incl) child, and you(sg) will_be_told by_him.”

4 Ne miggendiyad iya ka asawa ni Hirubuwam te baley ni Ahiyas diye te Silu. Kenad e egpakakita si Ahiyas su buyag e amana sikandin. 5 Piru ingkahiyan e daan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Ahiyas te egginguma ka asawa ni Hirubuwam eyew eg-inse meyitenged te anak dan ne migderalu. Ne ingkahiyan e te Magbebaye si Ahiyas ke nekey ka iglalag din.

4 And the spouse/wife of Hirubuwam went indeed to the house of Ahiyas there at Silu. Ahiyas couldn't see because he was already very old. 5 But the Lord God had already told Ahiyas that the spouse of Hirubuwam was_coming in_order to ask concerning their child that was_sick. And the Lord had told Ahiyas what he should_say.

Te nekeume e ka asawa ni Hirubuwam, ware sikandin migpeila ke hentew sikandin.6 Piru te pegkarineg ni Ahiyas te dahing te sikalan te asawa ni Hirubuwam te egseled te gumawan, migkahi e sikandin, “Lasud ka. Nakataha a ne sikeykew ka asawa ni Hirubuwam. Mania te kene ka egpeila ne sikeykew sika? Na, due mareet ne igpahuhud te Manama keddi diye te keykew. 7 Uli kad e wey kahii nu si Hirubuwam te seini ka inlalag kandin te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil, ‘In-alam ku sikeykew puun te langun ne etew wey inggimu ku sikeykew ne pangulu te keet-etawan ku ne me Israilita. 8 Inggawi ku ka migharian puun te kabuhalan ni Dabid wey imbehey kud seini keykew. Piru kene ka ne iling te suluhuanen ku ne si Dabid ne migtuman te me suhu ku, wey migpalintutuu keddiey te intiru ne pusung din. Iyan din de inggimu layun ka egpakapahale keddiey. 9 Subla pad ka sale ne neyimu nu du te sale te nenekewun-a keykew mighari. Mig-inniyuhan ad e nikeykew, wey migpangimu ke pad iya man-e te me diyus-diyus wey putew ne me larawan, sikan naa ka nalangetan a keykew. 10 [xr]Ne puun due, igpasalerep kud te karereetan ka kabuhalan nu wey egpangimatayan kud ka langun ne lukes ne kabuhalan nu, uripen ma wey se kene. Egdereetan kud iya ka kabuhalan nu, iling te egsilaban ne lapek ne ware egkengasame. 11 Ne egpangeenen te me asu ka langun ne egpamatey diye te siyudad, wey egpangeenen te me manuk-manuk ka egpamatey diye te unayan, su sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka miglalag kayi.’ ”

When the spouse of Hirubuwam arrived, she didn't reveal who she (was).6 But when Ahiyas heard the sound of the footsteps of the spouse of Hirubuwam as she entered in the doorway, he said, “Enter(sg). I know that you(sg) (are) the spouse of Hirubuwam. Why don't you(sg) reveal that it's you(sg)? Now, there's (something) bad that God told me to_tell you(sg). 7 Go_home(sg) and tell(sg) Hirubuwam that this (is) what_ the Lord God, the God of Israil _says to_him, ‘I chose you(sg) from all the people and I made you(sg) the leader of my people the Israilitas. 8 I retrieved the kingdom from the descendant(s) of Dabid and I gave it to_you(sg). But you(sg) are not like my servant Dabid who obeyed my commands, and obeyed/believed me with his whole heart. What he always did was pleasing to me. 9 The sin that you(sg) did (is) much worse than the sins of those who preceded(pl) you(sg) kinging. I've been_turned_away_from by_you(sg), and you(sg) have also indeed made(pl) false_gods and iron statues, that's why I'm angry at_you(sg). 10 [xr]And from that, I will_bring_disaster of destruction on your(sg) descendant(s) and I will_kill all your(sg) male descendants, slave(s) or not. I will_destroy indeed your(sg) descendant(s), like the burning of litter that has_ no _remainder. 11 And all those who die in the city will_be_eaten(pl) by dogs, and the (ones that) die there in the field will_be_eaten by birds, because I (am) the Lord God the (one who) is_saying this.’ ”

12 Ne migpabulus si Ahiyas ka migkahi te asawa ni Hirubuwam, “Ne, uli kad e diye te baley niyu. Ne emun egginguma kad e diye te siyudad niyu, egpatey e ka anak nu. 13 Ne egdamag kandin ka langun ne etew te igkahibang ne balabahan ne migharian te Israil, wey iglebeng e sikandin. Sikandin de ka kabuhalan ni Hirubuwam ne igpakaayad-ayad iglebeng, su sabsabeka rin de te ingkahale te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil. 14 Timul pad due, egpaharian te Magbebaye ne Manama ka Israil te Hari ne egdereet te peghari te kabuhalan ni Hirubuwam, wey egkeyitabu e sika kuntee. 15 Eglegparan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka Israil, wey egpekeiling sikandin te egpakalampes-lampes ne lelasangen diye te weyig. Ne egpaaween din e ka me etew puun kayi te matubung ne tane ne imbehey rin te me kaap-apuan dan. Egmegsuwayen din sikandan taman diye te kewun-aan te Weyig ne Iyupratis, su in-undulan dan ma ka langet te Magbebaye ne Manama te peggimu ran te me sungkaleg te diyus-diyus ne si Asira. 16 Eg-inniyuhan e sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama tenged te me sale ni Hirubuwam ne iyan egpuunan ne nakasale ka me matig-Israil.”

12 And Ahiyas continued speaking to the spouse of Hirubuwam, “So, return_home(sg) to your(pl) house. And when you(sg) arrive in your(pl) city, your(sg) child will_die. 13 And all the people of the northern kingdom of Israil will_mourn him, and will_bury him. And only he (is) the descendant of Hirubuwam that will_be_carefully buried, because only him is_pleasing to the Lord God of Israil. 14 Adding to that, the Lord God will_send_a_king of Israil that will_destroy the kinging of the descendant(sg) of Hirubuwam, and that will_happen today/now. 15 Israil will_be_punished by the Lord God, and it will_become_like a stick beaten_around in the river. And the people will_be_removed by_him from this abundant land that he gave to their ancestors. He will_spread_ them _out beyond the Iyupratis River, because they stoked the anger of the Lord God at their making of posts of false_god that's Asira. 16 And they will_be_turned_away by the Lord God because of the sin of Hirubuwam which_is the reason that the (ones) from_Israil sinned.”

17 Ne mig-uli en iya ka asawa ni Hirubuwam diye te Tirsa. Pegginguma rin de iya te gumawan te baley, migpatey e ka bate. 18 Ne migdamag ka langun ne Israilita kandin, wey inlebeng dan e sikandin. Ne iling iya rue ka inlalag te Manama ki Ahiyas, ka prupita ne suluhuanen din.

17 And the spouse of Hirubuwam went_home indeed to Tirsa. On her arrival indeed just at the doorway of the house, the child died. 18 And all the Israilitas mourned him, and they buried him. And that was just indeed like what_ God _had_said to Ahiyas, the prophet that (was) his servant.

Ka pegpatey ni Hirubuwam

The death of Hirubuwam

19 Ne ka duma pad ne neyimu ni Hirubuwam meyitenged te pegpakigbunu din wey te peghari din, nakasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Israil. 20 Daruwa ne pulu wey daruwa (22) ne leg-un ka peghari ni Hirubuwam. Nataman, migpatey e sikandin wey nekegdume e sikandin te kaap-apuan din, wey si Nadab ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

19 And the other_things done by Hirubuwam concerning his fighting_wars and his kinging, is_written there in the Writing of the Stories of the kings of Israil. 20 The kinging by Hirubuwam (was) for twenty-two (22) years. Then, he died and accompanied his ancestors, and his child Nadab replaced him kinging.

Ka peghari ni Rihubuwam te Huda

The kinging of Huda by Rihubuwam

(2 Kru 11:5–12:15)

(2 Chr 11:5–12:15)

21 Ne mighari degma diye te Huda si Rihubuwam ne anak ni Sulumun. Hep-at ne pulu wey sabeka (41) ka idad din te neyimu sikandin ne Hari te Huda. Mighari sikandin te sapulu wey pitu (17) ne leg-un diye te Hirusalim, ka siyudad ne in-alam te Magbebaye ne Manama puun te langun ne kabuhalan ne egpuun te me anak ni Hakub eyew egsimbaan kandin. Egngaranan ki Naama ka iney rin ne Amunihanen.

21 And Rihubuwam the child of Sulumun kinged also there in Huda. His was forty-one (41) years old when he became king of Huda. He kinged for seventeen (17) years there in Hirusalim, the city that was_chosen by the Lord God from all the group of descendants from one of the sons of Jacob where he would_be_worshiped. His mother the/an Amunihanon was_named Naama.

22 Ne mareet naan de iya ka inggimu te keet-etawan te Huda diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey subla pad ka inggimu ran du te inggimu te me kaap-apuan dan ne nakapeyibelu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 23 [xr]Migpangimu man-e sikandan te me panubaran diye te me bubungan, wey migpasasindeg sikandan te me pes-ek ne batu wey me sungkaleg te diyus-diyus ne si Asira diye te me bubungan wey diye te diralem te me kayu eyew egsimbeen dan. 24 [xr]Ne timul pad due, duen pad man-e me lukes ne egmamelegye te lawa diye te tane. Inggimu te me matig-Huda ka lilinditi naan de iya ne me himu iling te inggimu te keet-etawan ne imparelrel te Magbebaye ne Manama te me Israilita puun te tane dan eyew egpekeugpe kayi ka me Israilita.

22 And people of Huda did indeed just bad in the (thinking) of the Lord God, and what_ they _did was worse than what_was_done by their ancestors that provoked the Lord God to become_angry. 23 [xr]They again made sacrificing_places on the mountains, and they erected stone poles and posts of false_god that's Asira there on the mountains and there below trees in_order_for them to_worship. 24 [xr]Besides that, there_were also males that sell the body there in the land. The (ones) from_Huda did very_dirty actions/deeds like the people did previously when the Lord caused_ the Israilitas _to_chase_away from their land so_that the Israilitas would live here.

25 [xr]Te igkalalimma ne leg-un te peghari ni Rihubuwam, inlusuran e ni Sisak ne Hari te Ihiptu ka Hirusalim. 26 [xr]Impanguwa rin ka me karatuan te timplu te Magbebaye, wey te palasyu te Hari. Impanguwa rin ka langun, lagkes ka langun ne me kalasag ne bulawan ne impeyimu ni Sulumun. 27 Purisu, migpeyimu e man-e si Hari Rihubuwam te kalasag ne burunsi eyew igliwan te me kalasag, wey imbehey rin seini te me upisyal te me talagtameng te gumawan te palasyu. 28 Ne tagse eggendiye ka Hari te timplu te Magbebaye, eg-uyanen te me talagbantey rin ka me kalasag wey iglibed dan ded ka kalasag diye te malig-en ne tinesanan kayi.

25 [xr]In the fifth year of the kinging of Rihubuwam, Hirusalim was_invaded by Sisak the king of Ihiptu. 26 [xr]He took the wealth there in the temple of the Lord, and from the palace of the king. He took everything, including all the gold shields that Sulumun caused_to_make. 27 Therefore, king Rihubuwam asked_others_to_make bronze shields in_order to replace the shields, and he gave it to the officers of the palace guards. 28 And every time the king will_go to the temple of the Lord, his guards would carry the shields and they will_return the shields into the well_protected storage_places of them.

29 Ne ka duma pad ne neyimu ni Hari Rihubuwam, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Huda. 30 Te intiru ne timpu te peghari ni Rihubuwam, layun de sikandan egpabunbunuey ki Hirubuwam. 31 Te napatey e si Rihubuwam wey nekegdume e sikandin te me kaap-apuan din, wey insabal sikandin diye te Siyudad ni Dabid. Si Naama ka ngaran te iney rin ne Amunihanen. Ne si Abiyas ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

29 And the other_things done by King Rihubuwam, was_written there in the Writings of the Stories of the kings of Huda. 30 For the entire time of the kinging by Rihubuwam, he and Hirubuwam always just fought each_other. 31 When Rihubuwam died and he accompanied his ancestors, he wrap_and_store there in the City of Dabid. Ka peghari ni Abiyas te Huda

The kinging of Huda by Abiyas

(2 Kru 13:1–14:1)

(2 Chr 13:1–14:1)

151 Te igkasapulu wey walu (18) ne leg-un te peghari ni Hirubuwam ne anak ni Nibat diye te Israil, migbunsud e mighari si Abiyas te Huda. 2 Mighari sikandin te tatelu ne leg-un diye te Hirusalim. Si Maaka ka iney rin ne anak ni Absalum. 3 Ne in-ilingan din ded ka sale te amey rin, ware din sabekaa ka pusung din diye te Magbebaye ne Manama rin, kene ne iling te inggimu ni Dabid ne apu din. 4 [xr]Piru tenged ki Dabid, imbehayan ded si Abiyas te Magbebaye ne Manama rin te anak ne eghari subal kandin wey eggiresen te Hirusalim. 5 [xr]Su ka inggimu ni Dabid igkeele te Magbebaye ne Manama wey intuman din ka langun ne suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama te intiru ne umul rin, angin e te neyimu rin ki Uriyas ne Hitihanen. 6 [xr]Ne layun de egpabunbunuey ensi Rihubuwam wey si Hirubuwam taman te timpu te peghari ni Abiham. 7 Ne ka duma pad ne neyimu ni Abiyas, nakasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Huda. Ne nataman migpabunbunuey e degma ensi Abiyas wey Hirubuwam.

151 In the eighteenth (18) year of the kinging of Hirubuwam the child of Nibat there in Israil, Abiyas began ruling there in Huda. 2 He ruled for three years there in Hirusalim. Maaka the child of Absalum (was) his mother. 3 And he just copied the sin of his father, his heart also wasn't wholly commited to the Lord his God, not like what_was_done by Dabid his grandparent. 4 [xr]But due to Dabid, Abiyas was given child by the Lord his God to_king replacing him and to_make_secure Hirusalim. 5 [xr]Because what Dabid did is pleases to the Lord God and he obeyed all the commands of the Lord God for his entire life, except what_ he _did to Uriyas the Hitihanon. 6 [xr]And Rihubuwam and Hirubuwam always fighting until the time of the kinging by Abiham. 7 And the other_things done by Abiyas, was_written there in the Writings of the Stories of the kings of Huda. And then Abiyas and Hirubuwam also fighting_each_other.

8 Migpatey si Abiyas wey nekegdume e sikandin te me kaap-apuan din, wey insabal diye te Siyudad ni Dabid. Ne si Asa ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

8 Abiyas died and he accompanied his ancestors, and was_wrapped_and_stored there in the City of Dabid. And his child Asa replaced him kinging.

Ka peghari ni Asa te Huda

The kinging of Huda by Asa

(2 Kru 14:1‑5; 15:16–16:6, 11‑1 15:16–16:6, 11‑14)

(2 Chr 14:1‑5; 15:16–16:6, 11‑1 15:16–16:6, 11‑14)

9 Te igkararuwa ne pulu (20) ne leg-un te peghari ni Hirubuwam diye te Israil, neyimu e ne Hari si Asa diye te Huda. 10 Ne mighari sikandin diye te Hirusalim te hep-at ne pulu wey sabeka (41) ne leg-un. Apu sikandin ni Maaka, ka malitan ne anak ni Absalum. 11 Inggimu ni Asa ka igkeele te Magbebaye ne Manama iling te inggimu te apu din ne si Dabid. 12 [xr]Ne impandeldel rin puun te Huda ka langun ne me lukes ne egmamegye te lawa diye te me panubaran dan, wey impangawe din ka langun ne diyus-diyus ne impangimu te me kaap-apuan din. 13 Ne impaawe din degma ka apu din mismu ne si Maaka te pegkarayna, su migpasasindeg ma sikandin te me sungkaleg te diyus-diyus ne si Asira. Impepameled ni Asa ka me diyus-diyus ne sungkaleg wey impasilaban din e seini diye te napu te Kidrun. 14 Minsan ke ware naamin naawe ka me panubaran diye te me bubungan, insabeka red ni Asa ka pusung din diye te Magbebaye ne Manama rin te intiru ne umul rin. 15 Ne in-uyan din ka matulus ne kasangkapan ne inggimu rin wey te amey rin diye te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama lagkes ka pelata, bulawan, wey duma pad ne kasangkapan.

9 In the twentieth (20) year of the kinging of Hirubuwam there in Israil, Asa became king there in Huda. 10 And he kinged for forty-one (41) years there in Hirusalim. He was a grandchild of Maaka, the female child of Absalum. 11 Asa did what is pleases to the Lord God like what_ his ancestor Dabid _did. 12 [xr]And he sent_away(pl) from Huda all the males that sell (their) body there at their sacrificing_places, and he removed all the false_gods that were_made by his ancestors. 13 And he caused_to_remove also his own grandmother Maaka from being_queen, because she erected the posts of false_god that's Asira. Si Ilyas wey ka me prupita ni Baal

181 Te igkatatelu e ne leg-un te gulabung, impanengneng te Magbebaye ne Manama si Ilyas, “Hipanew ka, wey pakita ka ki Hari Ahab su egpeuranen kud e.” 2 Ne miggendiyad en iya si Ilyas te ki Ahab.

Ka katammanan te gulabung

The termination/end of drought

45 Te nalingen-ngen de iya, kenad egkakita ka langit te makepal ne kibel. Ne migpangalamag e, wey miglugsu e ka dakel ne uran. Ne nekewun-a pad sikandin te karwahi ni Ahab ka migpallahuy peendiye te gumawan te Hisril.

45 Just in_a_short_while, the sky couldn't be_seen due to thick dark_clouds. And it wind, and heavy (LIT big) rain fell. 191 Te nekeuli e si Hari Ahab, ingguhuran din e ka asawa rin ne si Hisibil te langun ne inggimu ni Ilyas, wey ke immenu rin te egpangimatey ka langun ne prupita. 2 Sikan naa ka impanahaan e ni Hisibil si Ilyas te migkahi, “Eggimatayan a te me manama ke kene ku eggimuwen kaaselem keykew ka inggimu nu te me prupita.” 3 Ne naaldek e si Ilyas wey miggendiyad e sikandin te Birsiba ne sakup te Huda, duma te suluhuanen din.

Ne inggaat din e diye ka suluhuanen din.4 [xr]Ne migpabulus e sikandin miggipanew ka sabsabeka te intiru ne aldew peendiye te disirtu. Ne migpinnuu pad sikandin diye te diralem te kayu, wey mig-ampu ne egkeupian e sikandin ne egpatey. Migkahi sikandin, “Magbebaye ne Manama, eleg e ubag. Angaya ad nikeykew, egkeupian ad ne egpatey iling te me apu ku!”

And he left_behind his servant there.4 [xr]And he continued traveling alone for the entire day towards the desert. And he sit there at the base of a tree, and prayed that he wanted to die. He said, “Lord God, that's enough please. Take(sg) me, I like to die like my grandparents!”

Ne migkeen e sikandin wey mig-inum, wey miggibat e man-e sikandin. 7 Ne miglibed e man-e ka panalihan te Manama wey impukew e man-e sikandin te migkahi, “Enew kad wey keen ke pa, su mariyu pad amana ka eggendiyaan nu.” 8 Ne mig-enew e man-e si Ilyas, wey migkeen wey mig-inum e sikandin. Ne migmanekal e sikandin tenged te ingkeen din, wey miggipanew e sikandin te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne aldew peendiye te Bubungan ne Sinay, ka bubungan te Manama. 9 Ne nekeume e sikandin diye te sulung wey diyad en iya sikandin miggirehe.

5 And he lay_down there at the base of the tree and he slept. And he got_stronger because of (what) he ate, and he traveled forty (40) days towards the Mount Sinay, the mountain of God. 9 And he arrived there at a cave and there he indeed overnighted.

Ne nenaperi ka me bubungan wey nenallupet ka me batu, piru ware diye te kalamag ka Magbebaye ne Manama. 19 Sikan naa ka miggipanew e si Ilyas wey nakita rin e si Ilisyu ne anak ni Sapat ka egdaru wey ka sapulu wey sabeka (11) ne me duma rin. Ka peglusud ni Bin-Hadad te Israil
