201 Ne inlibulung ni Bin-Hadad ne Hari te Sirya ka langun te sundalu rin eyew egpakigbunu. Indumaan sikandan te tatelu ne pulu wey daruwa (32) ne Hari duma te me kudde wey me karwahi ran. Inlingutan dan ka Samarya wey inlusuran dan seini. 2 Ne due me etew ne impeendiye ni Bin-Hadad te siyudad te Samarya eyew egpakahiyan si Ahab ne Hari te Israil, “Igkeupii ni Hari Bin-Hadad ne 3 igbehey nud kandin ka pelata wey bulawan nu, ka me mateles ne asawa nu wey ka me anak nu.”

201 And Bin-Hadad the king of Sirya gathered_together all his soldiers in_order to fight_war. They were accompanied by thirty-two (32) kings with their horses and their chariots. They encircled Samarya and they attacked it. 2 And there were people that Bin-Hadad sent towards the city of Samarya in_order to tell Ahab the king of Israil, “King Bin-Hahad wants 3 you(sg) to give him your(sg) silver and gold, your(sg) very_beautiful spouses and your(sg) children.”

4 Ne migtabak si Ahab, “Kahii niyu ka ahalen ku ne si Hari Bin-Hadad ne kandin en iya ka langun ne karatuan ku lagkes e ka umul ku.”

4 And Ahab answered, “Tell my master King Bin-Hadad that all my wealth is indeed his including my life.”

5 Nataman, migsuhu e man-e si Bin-Hadad te me etew rin peendiye ki Ahab wey impakahiyan din sikandin, “Migkahiyan kud e sikeykew te ibehey nud keddi ka pelata wey bulawan nu, ka me asawa nu wey ka me anak nu. 6 Piru egpeenduenen ku kaaselem keykew ka me suluhuanen ku te iling ded ne uras, eyew egpamitew diye te palasyu nu wey diye te me baley te upisyal nu. 5 Then, Bin-Hadad again commanded his people towards Ahab and he had_ him _told, “I told you(sg) to give(sg) me your(sg) silver and gold, your(sg) spouses and your(sg) children. 6 But I will_send_ my servants _there to_you(sg) tomorrow at this same hour, in_order to search there in your(sg) palace and there in the houses of your(sg) official(s). And they will_take(pl) whatever they want.”

7 Ne impeumew e ni Hari Ahab ka langun ne igbuyag te Israil wey migkahiyan din sikandan, “Pitawa niyu ka seini ne etew, egkeupian iya te gubut. Impakahiyan a nikandin te egkuen din e ka me asawa ku wey ka me anak ku, ka pelata wey ka bulawan ku, wey mig-uyun a iya te imbuyu din.”

7 And King Ahab sent_for all the elders of Israil and he told them, “Look(pl) at this person, (he) indeed desires war. I was_caused_to_be_told by_him that he'll take my spouses and my children, my silver and gold, and I indeed agreed him what_ he _requested.”

8 Piru migkahiyan sikandin te langun ne igbuyag wey te langun ne etew, “Kene ka pammineg kandin!”

8 But he was_told by all the elders and all the people, “Don't(sg) listen to him!”

9 Sikan naa ka migkahiyan din e ka me suluhuanen ni Bin-Hadad, “Kahii niyu ka ahalen ku ne Hari ne eg-uyun a te hun-a ne igkeupii rin, piru kena a eg-uyun te igkarangeb.”

9 So then he told the servants of Bin-Hadad, “Tell(pl) my master the king that I agreed to his first desire, but I don't agree to the second.”

Ne miglibed e ka me suluhuanen ni Bin-Hadad wey ingkahiyan dan e sikandin te impanaha ni Ahab kandan.10 Ne migpanahe e man-e si Bin-Hadad te migkahi, “Egtamtamanan a eglegpari te me manama ke kene egkahuhus egkatamtamani te me sundalu ku ka Samarya eyew warad iya egkasame minsan senge kemkem dan naan de.”

And the servants of Bin-Hadad returned and they told him what_ Ahab _had_informed them.10 And Bin-Hahad informed again saying, “(May) I be_severely punished by the gods if my soldiers do not completely destroy Samarya so that there's no remaining for them to have one-handful each.”

11 Ne migtabak ka Hari te Israil, “Kahii nu si Hari Bin-Hadad ne ka malehet ne sundalu, kene egpaambug te kene pad egkapenga ka pegbubunu.”

12 Nekeuma ki Bin-Hadad ka lalag ni Ahab te sasangan sikandin ne eg-iinum duma te me Hari diye te me leeb dan. Pegkarineg din dutu, impataggel rin e ka me sundalu rin eyew eglusud te siyudad. Ne migtaggel en iya sikandan.

12 The word of Ahab reached Bin-Hadad while he was_drinking along_with the kings there in their huts. On his hearing that, he had_ his soldiers _get_prepared in_order to invade the city. And they prepared indeed.

13 Ne due sabeka ne prupita ne migparani wey migpanengneng ki Hari Ahab te inlalag te Magbebaye ne Manama kandin ne miggenendue, “Kene ka kaaldek due te susuluhi ne me sundalu, su te seini ne aldew egpepanaluwen ku sikeykew kandan, wey eyew egkatahaan nu ne sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama.”

23 Ne ingkahiyan si Hari Bin-Hadad te me upisyal din, “Ka me manama te me Israilita, manama te me bubungan, sikan naa ka natalu ki nikandan. 18 And king Ahab said to Hihusapat, “I told you(sg) already that he would say not good_things to me; (it's) all just indeed bad_things.”

19 [xr]Migpabulus migkahi si Mikiyas, “Pammineha niyu ka lalag te Magbebaye. Nakita ku ka Magbebaye ne migpinuu te trunu rin, wey mig-andang kandin ne migsasindeg ka langun ne panalihan te langit diye te igkakawanan ne belad din wey diye te igkahibang din. 20 Ne migkahi ka Magbebaye, ‘Hentew ka eglimbung ki Ahab ne eglusud te Ramut-Gilyad eyew egpatey sikandin diye?’ Ware nekeg-iling ka tabak te me panalihan din. 21 Nataman, due panisingan ne migsasindeg diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye wey migkahi, ‘Sikeddiey ka eglimbung kandin.’ 22 Ne mig-insaan sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama, ‘Egmenuwen nu naa te eglimbung si Ahab?’ Ne migtabak sikandin, ‘Eggendiya a wey egpeuubaten ku ka langun ne me prupita ni Ahab.’ Ne migkahi ka Magbebaye, ‘Hendiye kad wey himuwa nu sika wey egkeubatan nu sikandin.’ ”

19 [xr]Mikiyas continued speaking, “Listen(pl) to the word of the Lord. I saw the Lord that sat on his throne, and all the angels in heaven stood beside him there on the right_side of his hand and on his left. 20 And the Lord said, ‘Who will_deceive Ahab to attack Ramut-Gilyad in_order for him to die there?’ The angels' answers did not match. 21 Then, there was a spirit that stood there in front of the Lord and said, ‘I (am) the (one who) will_deceive him.’ 22 And he was_asked by the Lord God, ‘How will_ you(sg) _deceive Ahab?’ And he answered, ‘I will_go_there and cause_ all the prophets of Ahab _lie.’ And the Lord said, ‘Go(sg) and do(sg) that and you(sg) will_deceive him.’ ”

23 Ne migkahi si Mikiyas, “Seeye ka neyitabu. Impeuyanan te Magbebaye seini se langun ne me prupita nu te panisingan ne egpeuubaten keykew. Igkeupii te Magbebaye ne egkareetan ka.”

23 And Mikiyas said, “That was what happened. The Lord sent a spirit to your(sg) all prophets who will_lie to you(sg). The Lord wants you(sg) to_be_destroyed.”

24 Ne migparani ki Mikiyas si Sidikiyas ne anak ni Kinaana wey intagpi din ka beneng ni Mikiyas wey migkahi, “Hendei bes mule migbaye ka Panisingan te Magbebaye ne mig-engked keddi eyew eglalag keykew?”

24 And Sidikiyas the child of Kinaana came_near to Mikiyas and he slapped the cheek of Mikiyas and said, “Where did the Spirit of the Lord go who left me in_order to speak to_you(sg)?”

25 Ne migtabak si Mikiyas, “Egkanengnengan nu sika ke eggeles kad diye te sinabeng.”

25 And Mikiyas answered, “You(sg) will_know it when you(sg) are hiding already in the room.”

26 Ne migsuhu si Hari Ahab, “Uyana niyu sikandin wey ipalibed niyu diye ki Amun ne gubirnadur te siyudad wey diye ki Huwas ne anak ku. 27 Kahii niyu sikandan te igpaprisu ku ka seini ne etew wey egbehayan de te deisek ne paan wey deisek ne weyig taman te egpekeuli a puun te pegbubunu ne kene egkamenu.”

26 And king Ahab commanded, “Take(pl) him and return(pl) him there to Amun the governor of the city and there to Huwas my child. 27 Tell(pl) them that I_have_ this person _be_imprisoned and be_given only a small bread and small water until I can_return from the fighting without being_harmed.”

28 Ne migkahi si Mikiyas, “Ke egpakalibed ka ne kene egkamenu, kene naa ne malehet ne impalalag keddi te Manama seini se langun.” Ne migkahi sikandin diye te me etew, “Tantanuri niyu ka inlalag ku.”

28 And Mikiyas said, “If you(sg) can_return in good_state (LIT won't be harmed), then it's not true that God caused_me_to_speak all of these.” And he said there to the people, “Remember(pl) what_ I _said.”

Ka pegpatey ni Ahab

The dying of Ahab

(2 Kru 18:28‑34)

(2 Chr 18:28‑34)

29 Purisu, miglusud diye te Ramut-Gilyad si Ahab ne Hari te Israil wey si Hihusapat ne Hari te Huda. 30 Ne migkahi si Ahab diye ki Hihusapat, “Kena a egpeila ne Hari a ka egbubunu. Ne saluub ka mule te igkukumbale te pegkahari.” Purisu, migbubunu sikandin ne kene egkeilaan ne Hari.

29 Therefore, Ahab the king of Israil attacked there in Ramut-Gilyad and Hihusapat the king of Huda. 30 And Hihusapat said to Ahab, “I will_ not _expose as king in fighting. But on_the_contrary wear(sg) a kingly cloth.” Therefore, he was_fighting not recognizable as a king.

31 Ne insuhu te Hari te Sirya ka tatelu ne pulu wey daruwa (32) ne me kumandir te me talag-uyan te me karwahi ne kene egpabunuen te minsan hentew angin e te Hari te Israil. 32 Te nakita te me kumandir te me talag-uyan te me karwahi si Hihusapat, kahiyen dan ne Hari sikandin te Israil, purisu indugpu dan sikandin eyew egbunuen wey migpanguleyi sikandin. 33 Ne te nakamaan-maan e seeye se me kumandir te me talag-uyan te kene bes ne sikandin ka Hari te Israil migsanggel e sikandan ka eglupug kandin. 34 Te sasangan pad ka gira, due etew ne egpanalasew re due ne egpamane ne nakasuhat te Hari te Israil. Diye sikandin nasuhat te temuwanan te igdingding te lawa ne insaluub din. Purisu, migkahi sikandin diye te talag-uyan te karwahi rin, “Ipariyu a nikeykew su napalian a.”

31 And the king of Sirya commanded thirty-two (32) the commanders of the takers of the chariots not to kill anybody except for the king of Israil. 32 When the commanders of the takers of the chariots saw Hihusapat, they thought that he was the king of Israil, therefore they approached him in_order to kill and he shouted. 33 And when those commanders of takers realized that he was not the king of Israil they stopped chasing him. 34 While the warring was going, there was a person who was shooting_an_arrow in_any_direction and hit the king of Israil. He was hit there in the joint of his body cover that he wore. Therefore, he said to the taker of his chariot, “Put_ me _away(sg) because I am wounded.”

35 Piru migmasumpit pad ka gira te seeye ne aldew, wey nakasandig naan de si Hari Ahab diye te karwahi rin ne nakatangke diye te me matig-Sirya taman te migpatey e sikandin te maapun e. Ne migpanulayas e ka langesa rin diye te seeg te karwahi. 36 Te eglineb e ka aldew, duen e narineg te me sundalu ne migpanguleyi ne miggenendue, “Panguli kew e langun diye te me inged niyu!”

35 But the war became_severe even more on that day, and King Ahab was just leaning on his chariot facing those from_Sirya until he died when the sun set. And his blood flowed there on the floor of the chariot. 36 When the sun set, there_was (someone) heard by the soldiers shouting going, “Go_home(pl) to your(pl) places!”

37 Ne migpatey en iya si Ahab wey in-uyan e ka lawa rin diye te Samarya wey inlebeng e sikandin. 38 Ne inlu-luan dan e ka karwahi rin diye te linew te Samarya ne pamanihusanan te me malitan ne egmamelegye te lawa, wey impandilaan te me asu ka langesa rin sumale iya te inlalag te Magbebaye ne Manama.

37 And Ahab died indeed and his body was_brought to Samarya and he was_buried. 38 And they cleaned his chariot there at the lake/pool of Samarya that was a_washing_place for women that sell(pl) their bodies, and his blood was licked_up by dogs indeed according_to_what the Lord God had_said.

39 Ne ka duma pad ne neyimu ni Ahab, ka peggimu rin te palasyu rin ne indayan-dayanan te sungey te ilipanti, wey ka langun ne siyudad ne impasasindeg din, nakasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Israil. 40 Ne migpatey e si Ahab wey nekegdume e sikandin te me kaap-apuan din. Ne si Ahasiyas ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

39 And the other_things done by Ahab, the making of his palace that was_decorated with elephant horn(s), and all the cities that he had_built, all is_written there in the Writing_places of the Stories of the kings of Israil. 40 Then Ahab died and he accompanied his ancestors. And his child Ahasiyas replaced him kinging.

Ka peghari ni Hihusapat te Huda

The kinging of Huda by Hihusapat

(2 Kru 20:31–21:1)

(2 Chr 20:31–21:1)

41 Te igkeep-at ne leg-un te peghari ni Ahab diye te Israil, neyimu e ne Hari te Huda si Hihusapat ne anak ni Asa. 42 Migbunsud si Hihusapat mighari te tatelu ne pulu wey lalimma (35) ka idad din. Mighari sikandin te daruwa ne pulu wey lalimma (25) ne leg-un diye te Hirusalim. Si Asuba ka iney rin ne anak ni Silhi. 43 In-ikul ni Hihusapat ka langun ne inggimu te Amey rin ne si Asa, wey inggimu rin ka meupiya diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. Piru ware naawe ka me panubaran diye te me bubungan wey migpabulus ded migmanubad ka me etew wey migmanutung te me insinsu diye. 44 Ne meupiya degma ka rilasyun din te Hari te Israil.

41 In the fourth year of the kinging of Israil by Ahab, Hihusapat the child of Asa became king there in Huda. 42 Hihusapat began ruling when his age was thirty five (35) years. He ruled for twenty five (25) years there in Hirusalim. His mother was Asuba the child of Silhi. 43 Hihusapat followed all that his father Asa did, and he did what's good there in front of the Lord. But the sacrificial_places in the mountains were not removed and the people just continued sacrificing(pl) and burning(pl) incense there. 44 And his relationship with the king of Israil was also good.

45 Ka duma pad ne neyimu ni Hihusapat te peghari din, ka kapanaluwan din wey ka me pegbubunu din, nakasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Huda. 46 Te mighari e sikandin, impangimatayan din e ka langun ne lukes wey me malitan ne egmamelegye te lawa diye te me panubaran diye te me bubungan, ne nenasame te timpu te peghari te amey rin ne si Asa.

45 And the other_things done by Hihusapat of his kinging, his accomplishment and his wars, all is_written there in the Writing_places of the Stories of the kings of Huda. 46 When he kinged, he killed all the males and females that sold(pl) (their) bodies there at the mountain of sacrificing_place there on the mountains, that remained in the time of the kinging of his father Asa.

47 Te seeye ne timpu, ware Hari te me matig-Idum; impanguluwan de sikandan te etew ne in-alam ni Hari Hihusapat.

47 At that time, the (ones) from_Idum had_no king; they were_ just _led by a person chosen by King Hihusapat.

48 Ne migpangimu si Hihusapat te me barku te Tarsis ne igpeendiye te inged te Upir eyew eg-angey te bulawan. Piru warad e sikandan nekeendiye su nagguhus ma iya ka me barku diye te Isyun-Gibir. 49 Te seeye ne timpu, ingkahiyan sikandin ni Ahasiyas ne anak ni Ahab, “Parumaa nu ka me etew ku te me etew nu ne egmanlawang.” Piru ware mig-uyun si Hihusapat.

48 And Hihusapat made ships there at Tarsis that rafted/sailed(pl) towards the place of Upir in_order to_fetch gold. But they didn't go_there because the ships were_demolished(pl) there at Isyun-Gibir. 49 At that time, he was_told by Ahasiyas the child of Ahab, “(Let) my people accompany in rafting/sailing.” But Hihusapat didn't agree.

50 Ne migpatey si Hihusapat wey insabal diye te insabalan te me kaap-apuan din diye te Siyudad ni Dabid. Ne si Hihuram e ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

50 And Husapat died and wrap_and_stored there in the City of Dabid. And his child Hihuram replaced him kinging.

Ka peghari ni Ahasiyas te Israil

The kinging of Israil by Ahasiyas

51 Te igkasapulu wey pitu (17) ne leg-un te peghari ni Hihusapat te Huda, neyimu e ne Hari te Israil si Ahasiyas ne anak ni Ahab, wey diye sikandin mig-ugpe te Samarya. Mighari sikandin diye te intiru ne Israil te daruwa ne leg-un. 52 Mareet naan de iya ka inggimu rin diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey in-ikul rin ded ka hinimuwan te amey wey iney rin, wey ka hinimuwan ni Hirubuwam ne anak ni Nibat ne iyan egpuunan ne nakasale ka me Israilita. 53 Migsimba degma sikandin ki Baal, wey impeyibelu din ka Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil iling te inggimu te amey rin.

51 In the seventeenth (17) year of the kinging of Huda by Hihusapat, Ahasiyas the child of Ahab became king of Israil, and he lived there in Samarya. He kinged over entire Israil for two years. 52 He did indeed just bad in the (thinking) of the Lord God, and he just followed/imitated the actions of his father and mother, and the actions of Hirubuwam the child of Nibat that (was) the reason that the Israilitas sinned. 53 He also worshiped Baal, and he provoked the Lord God, the God of Israil to_anger like his father did.
